metadata.title: LearningO - Math / Listen
metadata.subject: Math
metadata.generated_for: Children with dyslexia and other learning differences, approx. ages 5-10
design_principles: Every question is answerable purely by ear - number words, quantities, and story problems are all spoken, not printed.
Numbers stay developmentally appropriate: single digits and easy teens at Foundation, growing to two-digit arithmetic and simple fractions by Independent.
Wrong options are never random. Each one names a specific, common calculation slip (off-by-one, wrong operation, digit reversal, recency bias).
Three difficulty bands rotate inside every type: easy for fluency, medium for the learning edge, happy for pure joy.
Real-life contexts (money, time, sharing, measuring) are used wherever they fit naturally, so number sense and life skills grow together.
Feedback praises the process, never the child's intelligence.
Safety, honesty and help-seeking items carry a mastery_weight above 1.0 so they surface in reports even when accuracy overall is high.

tts_guidance.note: Read audio_text exactly as written when read-aloud support is used. For sequence and multi-select items, pause 500ms between listed items.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: matching heard number words to written digits
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline check that a spoken number word connects to its numeral, before any calculation is asked.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: connecting a spoken number word to a set of objects of that size
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests true cardinality - that the number represents a quantity, not just a memorised word.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: checking a spoken quantity claim against a picture
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Confirms the child listens to the whole statement rather than reacting to the picture alone.
A speed-oriented variant of type 1, useful for tracking automaticity over time.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: connecting a heard shape word to a visual shape
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Early geometry vocabulary, a foundation for later measurement and spatial reasoning.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: locating a number's position relative to another in the count sequence
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests internalised number order, not just forward counting from one.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding two heard numbers in mind and comparing their size
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Requires holding both numbers simultaneously, a genuine working-memory step beyond single-number recall.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: identifying and extending a rule from a short spoken sequence
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Early algebraic reasoning - spotting a rule and predicting forward, a skill that scales to all later maths.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: extending a skip-counting sequence heard aloud
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Skip counting is the direct precursor to multiplication and a strong predictor of later maths fluency.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: extracting the needed numbers from a short spoken story and calculating
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The first true applied-maths task in the module - numbers now live inside a real-world sentence.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding an intermediate result in mind while solving a second step
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A genuine leap in working-memory load - the first result must be held while a second calculation runs.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: using coin values or clock positions heard aloud to answer a question
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Connects abstract number sense to two of the most immediately useful real-world number systems.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reasoning about relative measurement from a spoken description
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Measurement vocabulary (taller, heavier, more) used without a ruler builds intuitive quantity sense first.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reasoning about equal parts of a whole from a spoken sharing scenario
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Introduces fractions through the intuitive, familiar idea of fair sharing rather than abstract notation.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding three heard numbers in mind and ranking them
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest working-memory task in the module - three numbers must be held and compared simultaneously, purely from sound.

difficulty_band.easy: Consolidation. Child should succeed ~90% of the time. Builds fluency and confidence.
difficulty_band.medium: Learning edge. Target ~65-75% success. This is where growth data lives.
difficulty_band.happy: Pure joy question. Near-certain success, silly or warm content, low mastery weight. Placed to reset mood after effort and to keep the session feeling like play.

reporting_recipes.skill_profile: Group accuracy by academic.skill and cognition.process to find the child's cognitive shape (e.g. strong discriminate / weak sequence).
reporting_recipes.life_skill_radar: Group accuracy by life_skill.domain across all subjects to build a 14-spoke life-skill radar chart per child.
reporting_recipes.dyslexia_error_map: Count wrong answers by distractor_insight value, not just by question. The distractor tells you WHY, so one wrong tap becomes a diagnosis.
reporting_recipes.attention_curve: Plot time_to_first_touch and accuracy against telemetry.session_position to find the child's real attention span, then cap session length there.
reporting_recipes.working_memory_ceiling: Accuracy vs cognition.working_memory_load. The load level where accuracy drops below 60% is the child's current WM ceiling - never exceed it during teaching.
reporting_recipes.confidence_calibration: Compare the wellbeing.confidence_prompt answer with actual correctness. Confident+wrong = misconception to correct. Unsure+right = needs reassurance, not more teaching.
reporting_recipes.impulsivity_index: Wrong answers where time_to_first_touch < 25% of expected_response_time_ms. High index means teach 'wait and think', not more content.
reporting_recipes.persistence_index: Retry rate and abandon rate on medium-band items. Falling persistence over weeks is an early wellbeing flag.
reporting_recipes.mood_trend: Track emotion_checkin responses over sessions. Two sad check-ins in a row should lower difficulty automatically for the next session.
reporting_recipes.personality_map: Aggregate personality_signal outcomes to describe tendencies (e.g. cautious, highly pro-social, low help-seeking) for the parent report.

wellbeing_rules: No question ever shows a countdown clock. Speed is rewarded, never punished.
Feedback praises the process ('you listened right to the end'), never the child's intelligence.
After two wrong answers the app shows how it works instead of asking again.
A happy-band question follows any run of three errors.
Every safety and help-seeking question points the child towards a trusted grown-up.

questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the number.
questions.audio_text: three

distractor_insight.8: visually similar shape to 3 when reversed

hints: Three fingers. Count them: 1, 2, 3.
questions.worked_example: Listen for the number word. Find the matching numeral.

feedback.correct: 3. Matched perfectly. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Hold up three fingers and count them.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: mapping a spoken number word to a numeral

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Numbers are just a fast way to say how many.

analysis.primary_construct: matching heard number words to written digits
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline check that a spoken number word connects to its numeral, before any calculation is asked.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Consistently picking a numeral that looks similar (6 for 9) rather than sounds similar suggests visual, not auditory, confusion.
analysis.parent_note: This confirms your child connects number words to the numerals that represent them.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice saying a number and writing the numeral together, out loud.

analysis.primary_construct: connecting a spoken number word to a set of objects of that size
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests true cardinality - that the number represents a quantity, not just a memorised word.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking a set with roughly the right size (off by one) rather than a random one suggests estimation without exact counting.
analysis.parent_note: This is the real foundation of number sense: knowing a number means an amount.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Count objects aloud together often, touching each one as you say the number.

hints: Bilde Fünfergruppen, um die Anzahl zu prüfen.
de.worked_example: Höre auf die Zahl. Zähle die Bilder, bis du dort angekommen bist.

feedback.correct: Dreizehn Schmetterlinge, genau gezählt. Das ist echte Zähl-Ausdauer. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Versuch in Fünfern zu zählen: fünf, zehn, und dann den Rest.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het plaatje met dat aantal.
nl.audio_text: dertien
hints: Groepeer ze in vijven om het aantal te controleren.
nl.worked_example: Luister naar het getal. Tel de plaatjes tot je daar komt.

feedback.correct: Dertien vlinders, precies geteld. Dat is echt doorzettingsvermogen bij het tellen. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Probeer in vijven te tellen: vijf, tien, en dan de rest.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Послушай. Нажми на картинку с этим количеством.
hints: Сгруппируй по пять, чтобы проверить счёт.
ru.worked_example: Слушай число. Считай картинки, пока не дойдёшь до него.

feedback.correct: Тринадцать бабочек, точно посчитано. Настоящая выдержка в счёте! 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Попробуй считать по пять: пять, десять, а потом остаток.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Dinle. O kadar olan resme dokun.
tr.audio_text: on üç
hints: Sayıyı kontrol etmek için beşerli gruplar halinde say.
tr.worked_example: Sayıyı dinle. Ona ulaşana kadar resimleri say.

feedback.correct: On üç kelebek, tam olarak sayıldı. Gerçek bir sayma dayanıklılığı. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Beşerli saymayı dene: beş, on, sonra kalanı.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 听。点击数量相符的图片。
zh.audio_text: 十三
hints: 五个一组地数,检查数量。

feedback.correct: 十三只蝴蝶,数得精确。这真需要耐心。🦋
feedback.incorrect: 试着五个一组地数:五、十,然后剩下的。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。その数だけある絵をタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: じゅうさん

feedback.correct: チョウ13匹、ぴったり数えられたね。最後まで集中して数えられたね。🦋
feedback.incorrect: 5つずつ数えよう:5、10、そして残り。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 들어보세요. 그 수만큼 있는 그림을 누르세요.

feedback.correct: 나비 열세 개, 정확히 세었어요. 끝까지 집중해서 아주 잘 세었어요. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: 다섯씩 세어 보세요: 다섯, 열, 그리고 나머지.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan. Sentuh gambar dengan jumlah itu.
id.audio_text: tiga belas
hints: Kelompokkan lima-lima untuk memeriksa hitungannya.
id.worked_example: Dengarkan angkanya. Hitung gambar-gambar itu sampai mencapainya.

feedback.correct: Tiga belas kupu-kupu, berhasil dihitung dengan tepat. Itu daya tahan menghitung yang sungguh hebat. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Coba hitung lima-lima: lima, sepuluh, lalu sisanya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào hình có đúng số lượng đó.

feedback.correct: Mười ba con bướm, đếm chính xác rồi. Đó là sự kiên trì đếm số thực sự. 🦋
feedback.incorrect: Hãy thử đếm theo từng năm: năm, mười, rồi phần còn lại.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Is it true?
questions.audio_text: There are three apples.
hints: Count the apples shown.
questions.worked_example: Count what you see. Does it match what you heard?

feedback.correct: True. Three, exactly. 🍎
feedback.incorrect: Count the apples again before deciding.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: verifying a simple spoken number statement

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Checking your count once more catches most mistakes.

analysis.primary_construct: checking a spoken quantity claim against a picture
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Confirms the child listens to the whole statement rather than reacting to the picture alone.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Fast wrong answers regardless of content suggest guessing without listening to the full sentence.
analysis.parent_note: Shows whether your child checks a claim carefully before answering.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask your child to recount out loud before deciding true or false.

feedback.incorrect: 비스킷 두 개를 두 사람에게 나누어 보세요. 한 명당 몇 개일까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Jika kamu membagi dua biskuit sama rata antara dua teman, masing-masing mendapat dua.
hints: Dua biskuit untuk dua orang - berapa masing-masing?
id.worked_example: Hitung apa yang kamu lihat. Apakah itu sesuai dengan yang kamu dengar?

feedback.correct: Salah. Setiap teman mendapat satu, bukan dua. 🍪
feedback.incorrect: Bagi dua biskuit untuk dua orang. Berapa yang masing-masing dapatkan?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Điều đó có đúng không?
vi.audio_text: Nếu em chia đều hai cái bánh quy cho hai người bạn, mỗi người sẽ được hai cái.
hints: Hai cái bánh quy chia cho hai người - mỗi người được bao nhiêu?
vi.worked_example: Đếm những gì em thấy. Có khớp với điều em nghe không?

feedback.correct: Sai. Mỗi người bạn được một cái, không phải hai. 🍪
feedback.incorrect: Chia hai cái bánh quy cho hai người. Mỗi người được bao nhiêu cái?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Is it true?
questions.audio_text: A rectangle has four sides.
hints: Count the sides of a rectangle in your mind.
questions.worked_example: Count what you see. Does it match what you heard?

feedback.correct: True. Four sides, four corners. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Picture a rectangle and count its sides.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: verifying a simple spoken number statement

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Knowing shape facts helps you describe the world precisely.

analysis.primary_construct: checking a spoken quantity claim against a picture
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Confirms the child listens to the whole statement rather than reacting to the picture alone.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Fast wrong answers regardless of content suggest guessing without listening to the full sentence.
analysis.parent_note: Shows whether your child checks a claim carefully before answering.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask your child to recount out loud before deciding true or false.

es.instruction: Escucha. ¿Es verdad?
es.audio_text: Un rectángulo tiene cuatro lados.
hints: Cuenta mentalmente los lados de un rectángulo.
es.worked_example: Cuenta lo que ves. ¿Coincide con lo que escuchaste?

feedback.correct: Verdadero. Cuatro lados, cuatro esquinas. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Imagina un rectángulo y cuenta sus lados.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: Un rectangle a quatre côtés.
hints: Compte les côtés d'un rectangle dans ta tête.
fr.worked_example: Compte ce que tu vois. Est-ce que ça correspond à ce que tu as entendu ?

feedback.correct: Vrai. Quatre côtés, quatre coins. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Imagine un rectangle et compte ses côtés.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. É verdade?
pt.audio_text: Um retângulo tem quatro lados.
hints: Conte os lados de um retângulo em sua mente.
pt.worked_example: Conte o que você vê. Combina com o que você ouviu?

feedback.correct: Verdadeiro. Quatro lados, quatro cantos. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Imagine um retângulo e conte seus lados.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. È vero?
it.audio_text: Un rettangolo ha quattro lati.
hints: Conta i lati di un rettangolo nella tua mente.
it.worked_example: Conta quello che vedi. Corrisponde a quello che hai sentito?

feedback.correct: Vero. Quattro lati, quattro angoli. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Immagina un rettangolo e conta i suoi lati.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Ist das wahr?
de.audio_text: Ein Rechteck hat vier Seiten.
hints: Zähle im Kopf die Seiten eines Rechtecks.
de.worked_example: Zähle, was du siehst. Stimmt es mit dem Gehörten überein?

feedback.correct: Wahr. Vier Seiten, vier Ecken. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Stell dir ein Rechteck vor und zähle seine Seiten.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Is het waar?
nl.audio_text: Een rechthoek heeft vier zijden.
hints: Tel de zijden van een rechthoek in je gedachten.
nl.worked_example: Tel wat je ziet. Komt dat overeen met wat je hoorde?

feedback.correct: Waar. Vier zijden, vier hoeken. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Stel je een rechthoek voor en tel de zijden.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

hints: Мысленно посчитай стороны прямоугольника.
ru.worked_example: Посчитай то, что видишь. Совпадает ли это с тем, что услышал?

feedback.correct: Правда. Четыре стороны, четыре угла. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Представь прямоугольник и посчитай его стороны.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Bir dikdörtgenin dört kenarı vardır.
hints: Zihninde bir dikdörtgenin kenarlarını say.
tr.worked_example: Gördüğünü say. Duyduğunla eşleşiyor mu?

feedback.correct: Doğru. Dört kenar, dört köşe. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Bir dikdörtgen hayal et ve kenarlarını say.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 长方形有四条边。
hints: 在脑海里数一数长方形的边。
zh.worked_example: 数一数你看到的。和你听到的一样吗?

feedback.correct: 对。四条边,四个角。▭
feedback.incorrect: 想象一个长方形,数一数它的边。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。これは本当かな?
ja.audio_text: 長方形には4つの辺があります。
hints: 頭の中で長方形の辺を数えよう。
ja.worked_example: 見えるものを数えよう。聞いたことと合っているかな?

feedback.correct: 本当だよ。辺が4つ、角も4つだね。▭
feedback.incorrect: 長方形を思い浮かべて、辺を数えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 직사각형은 변이 네 개예요.
hints: 머릿속으로 직사각형의 변을 세어 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 보이는 것을 세어 보세요. 들은 내용과 같은가요?

feedback.correct: 맞아요. 변 네 개, 꼭짓점 네 개예요. ▭
feedback.incorrect: 직사각형을 떠올리며 변을 세어 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Persegi panjang memiliki empat sisi.
hints: Hitung sisi persegi panjang dalam pikiranmu.
id.worked_example: Hitung apa yang kamu lihat. Apakah itu sesuai dengan yang kamu dengar?

feedback.correct: Benar. Empat sisi, empat sudut. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Bayangkan persegi panjang dan hitung sisi-sisinya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Điều đó có đúng không?
vi.audio_text: Hình chữ nhật có bốn cạnh.
hints: Đếm số cạnh của hình chữ nhật trong đầu.
vi.worked_example: Đếm những gì em thấy. Có khớp với điều em nghe không?

feedback.correct: Đúng. Bốn cạnh, bốn góc. ▭
feedback.incorrect: Hình dung một hình chữ nhật và đếm các cạnh của nó.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Is it true?
questions.audio_text: A triangle has four sides.

distractor_insight.✅ Yes: confused triangle with a four-sided shape

hints: Count the sides of a triangle.
questions.worked_example: Count what you see. Does it match what you heard?

feedback.correct: False. A triangle has three sides, not four. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Picture a triangle and count its sides again.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: verifying a simple spoken number statement

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Tri means three - the name itself is a clue.

analysis.primary_construct: checking a spoken quantity claim against a picture

es.instruction: Escucha. ¿Es verdad?
es.audio_text: Un triángulo tiene cuatro lados.
hints: Cuenta los lados de un triángulo.
es.worked_example: Cuenta lo que ves. ¿Coincide con lo que escuchaste?

feedback.incorrect: Imagina un triángulo y cuenta sus lados de nuevo.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: Un triangle a quatre côtés.
hints: Compte les côtés d'un triangle.
fr.worked_example: Compte ce que tu vois. Est-ce que ça correspond à ce que tu as entendu ?

feedback.correct: Faux. Un triangle a trois côtés, pas quatre. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Imagine un triangle et compte encore ses côtés.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. É verdade?
pt.audio_text: Um triângulo tem quatro lados.
hints: Conte os lados de um triângulo.
pt.worked_example: Conte o que você vê. Combina com o que você ouviu?

feedback.correct: Falso. Um triângulo tem três lados, não quatro. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Imagine um triângulo e conte seus lados novamente.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. È vero?
it.audio_text: Un triangolo ha quattro lati.
hints: Conta i lati di un triangolo.
it.worked_example: Conta quello che vedi. Corrisponde a quello che hai sentito?

feedback.correct: Falso. Un triangolo ha tre lati, non quattro. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Immagina un triangolo e conta di nuovo i suoi lati.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Ist das wahr?
de.audio_text: Ein Dreieck hat vier Seiten.
hints: Zähle die Seiten eines Dreiecks.
de.worked_example: Zähle, was du siehst. Stimmt es mit dem Gehörten überein?

feedback.correct: Falsch. Ein Dreieck hat drei Seiten, nicht vier. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Stell dir ein Dreieck vor und zähle seine Seiten noch einmal.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Is het waar?
nl.audio_text: Een driehoek heeft vier zijden.
hints: Tel de zijden van een driehoek.
nl.worked_example: Tel wat je ziet. Komt dat overeen met wat je hoorde?

feedback.correct: Niet waar. Een driehoek heeft drie zijden, niet vier. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Stel je een driehoek voor en tel de zijden nog eens.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

hints: Посчитай стороны треугольника.
ru.worked_example: Посчитай то, что видишь. Совпадает ли это с тем, что услышал?

feedback.correct: Неправда. У треугольника три стороны, а не четыре. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Представь треугольник и посчитай его стороны ещё раз.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Bir üçgenin dört kenarı vardır.
hints: Bir üçgenin kenarlarını say.
tr.worked_example: Gördüğünü say. Duyduğunla eşleşiyor mu?

feedback.correct: Yanlış. Bir üçgenin dört değil, üç kenarı vardır. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Bir üçgen hayal et ve kenarlarını tekrar say.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 三角形有四条边。
hints: 数一数三角形的边。
zh.worked_example: 数一数你看到的。和你听到的一样吗?

feedback.correct: 错。三角形有三条边,不是四条。🔺
feedback.incorrect: 想象一个三角形,再数一数它的边。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。これは本当かな?
ja.audio_text: 三角形には4つの辺があります。
hints: 三角形の辺を数えよう。
ja.worked_example: 見えるものを数えよう。聞いたことと合っているかな?

feedback.correct: 違うよ。三角形の辺は4つじゃなく3つだね。🔺
feedback.incorrect: 三角形を思い浮かべて、もう一度辺を数えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 삼각형은 변이 네 개예요.
hints: 삼각형의 변을 세어 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 보이는 것을 세어 보세요. 들은 내용과 같은가요?

feedback.correct: 틀렸어요. 삼각형은 변이 네 개가 아니라 세 개예요. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: 삼각형을 떠올리며 변을 다시 세어 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Segitiga memiliki empat sisi.
hints: Hitung sisi segitiga.
id.worked_example: Hitung apa yang kamu lihat. Apakah itu sesuai dengan yang kamu dengar?

feedback.correct: Salah. Segitiga memiliki tiga sisi, bukan empat. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Bayangkan segitiga dan hitung lagi sisi-sisinya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Điều đó có đúng không?
vi.audio_text: Hình tam giác có bốn cạnh.
hints: Đếm số cạnh của hình tam giác.
vi.worked_example: Đếm những gì em thấy. Có khớp với điều em nghe không?

feedback.correct: Sai. Hình tam giác có ba cạnh, không phải bốn. 🔺
feedback.incorrect: Hình dung một hình tam giác và đếm lại các cạnh của nó.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Is it true?
questions.audio_text: There are three ducks, and they are all wearing hats.

distractor_insight.✅ Yes: only checked the number, not the whole silly claim

hints: The count is right - but check the whole sentence, hats and all.
questions.worked_example: Count what you see. Does it match what you heard?

feedback.incorrect: Check every part of the sentence, not just the number.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Careful checking means reading the whole claim, not just part of it.

analysis.primary_construct: checking a spoken quantity claim against a picture
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Confirms the child listens to the whole statement rather than reacting to the picture alone.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Fast wrong answers regardless of content suggest guessing without listening to the full sentence.
analysis.parent_note: Shows whether your child checks a claim carefully before answering.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask your child to recount out loud before deciding true or false.

es.instruction: Escucha. ¿Es verdad?
es.audio_text: Hay tres patos, y todos llevan sombrero.
hints: El conteo es correcto, pero comprueba toda la frase, sombreros incluidos.
es.worked_example: Cuenta lo que ves. ¿Coincide con lo que escuchaste?

feedback.correct: Falso: tres patos es correcto, ¡pero aquí no hay sombreros! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: Comprueba cada parte de la frase, no solo el número.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: Il y a trois canards, et ils portent tous un chapeau.
hints: Le compte est bon - mais vérifie toute la phrase, chapeaux compris.
fr.worked_example: Compte ce que tu vois. Est-ce que ça correspond à ce que tu as entendu ?

feedback.correct: Faux - trois canards c'est juste, mais pas de chapeaux ici ! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: Vérifie chaque partie de la phrase, pas seulement le nombre.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. É verdade?
pt.audio_text: Há três patos, e todos estão usando chapéus.
hints: A contagem está certa - mas verifique a frase toda, chapéus e tudo.
pt.worked_example: Conte o que você vê. Combina com o que você ouviu?

feedback.correct: Falso - três patos está certo, mas aqui não há chapéus! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: Verifique cada parte da frase, não apenas o número.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. È vero?
it.audio_text: Ci sono tre anatre, e indossano tutte un cappello.
hints: Il conteggio è giusto - ma controlla tutta la frase, cappelli compresi.
it.worked_example: Conta quello che vedi. Corrisponde a quello che hai sentito?

feedback.correct: Falso - tre anatre è giusto, ma qui non ci sono cappelli! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: Controlla ogni parte della frase, non solo il numero.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Ist das wahr?
de.audio_text: Es sind drei Enten, und sie tragen alle Hüte.
hints: Die Anzahl stimmt - aber prüfe den ganzen Satz, auch die Hüte.
de.worked_example: Zähle, was du siehst. Stimmt es mit dem Gehörten überein?

feedback.correct: Falsch - drei Enten ist richtig, aber hier gibt es keine Hüte! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: Prüfe jeden Teil des Satzes, nicht nur die Zahl.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Is het waar?
nl.audio_text: Er zijn drie eenden, en ze dragen allemaal een hoed.
hints: Het aantal klopt - maar controleer de hele zin, hoeden en alles.
nl.worked_example: Tel wat je ziet. Komt dat overeen met wat je hoorde?

feedback.correct: Niet waar - drie eenden is juist, maar hier zijn geen hoeden! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: Controleer elk deel van de zin, niet alleen het getal.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Здесь три утки, и все они в шляпах.
hints: Количество верное — но проверь всё предложение, включая шляпы.
ru.worked_example: Посчитай то, что видишь. Совпадает ли это с тем, что услышал?

feedback.correct: Неправда — три утки верно, но шляп здесь нет! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: Проверь каждую часть предложения, а не только число.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Üç ördek var ve hepsi şapka takıyor.
hints: Sayı doğru - ama cümlenin tamamını kontrol et, şapkalar dahil.
tr.worked_example: Gördüğünü say. Duyduğunla eşleşiyor mu?

feedback.correct: Yanlış - üç ördek doğru, ama burada şapka yok! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: Sadece sayıyı değil, cümlenin her bölümünü kontrol et.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.audio_text: 这里有三只鸭子,它们都戴着帽子。
hints: 数量是对的——但要检查整句话,包括帽子。
zh.worked_example: 数一数你看到的。和你听到的一样吗?

feedback.correct: 错——三只鸭子是对的,但这里没有帽子!🦆
feedback.incorrect: 检查句子的每个部分,不只是数字。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。これは本当かな?
ja.audio_text: アヒルが3羽いて、みんな帽子をかぶっています。
hints: 数は合っているよ。でも帽子のことも含めて、文全体を確認しよう。

feedback.correct: 違うよ。アヒル3羽は合っているけど、帽子はかぶっていないよ!🦆
feedback.incorrect: 数字だけでなく、文の全部を確認しよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 오리가 세 마리 있고, 모두 모자를 쓰고 있어요.
hints: 개수는 맞아요 - 하지만 모자까지 포함해서 문장 전체를 확인하세요.
ko.worked_example: 보이는 것을 세어 보세요. 들은 내용과 같은가요?

feedback.correct: 틀렸어요 - 오리 세 마리는 맞지만, 모자는 쓰고 있지 않아요! 🦆
feedback.incorrect: 숫자만 보지 말고 문장의 모든 부분을 확인하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Ada tiga bebek, dan semuanya memakai topi.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the bigger (or smaller) number.
questions.audio_text: Which is bigger, 3 or 7?

distractor_insight.3: picked the number said first, not compared

hints: Which number would you count to last?

feedback.correct: 7. The bigger number. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Think about which one you'd reach later when counting.

academic.skill: comparing two spoken quantities

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Comparing amounts helps you choose the better deal, the bigger portion, and more.

analysis.primary_construct: holding two heard numbers in mind and comparing their size
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Requires holding both numbers simultaneously, a genuine working-memory step beyond single-number recall.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking the number said second (recency) rather than the mathematically larger one shows memory load, not comparison error.
analysis.parent_note: Comparing sizes is used constantly - more, less, bigger, smaller - in everyday choices.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real quantities together throughout the day: which plate has more?

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the bigger (or smaller) number.
questions.audio_text: Which is smaller, 23 or 32?

distractor_insight.32: digits look similar but this is genuinely the bigger number

academic.skill: comparing two spoken quantities

life_skill.hidden_lesson: The first digit of a two-digit number usually decides which is bigger.

analysis.primary_construct: holding two heard numbers in mind and comparing their size
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Requires holding both numbers simultaneously, a genuine working-memory step beyond single-number recall.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking the number said second (recency) rather than the mathematically larger one shows memory load, not comparison error.
analysis.parent_note: Comparing sizes is used constantly - more, less, bigger, smaller - in everyday choices.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real quantities together throughout the day: which plate has more?

questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the bigger (or smaller) number.
questions.audio_text: Which is smaller, 17 or 71?

distractor_insight.71: digit-reversal confusion, a genuinely tricky comparison

hints: Compare the tens digit: 1 or 7?
questions.worked_example: Hold both numbers in mind. Which one would come later if you counted?

feedback.correct: 17. Correctly told apart from its reversed twin. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: These two use the same digits in a different order. Compare the tens digit.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comparing two spoken quantities

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Same digits, different order, very different size - always worth double-checking.

analysis.primary_construct: holding two heard numbers in mind and comparing their size
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Requires holding both numbers simultaneously, a genuine working-memory step beyond single-number recall.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking the number said second (recency) rather than the mathematically larger one shows memory load, not comparison error.
analysis.parent_note: Comparing sizes is used constantly - more, less, bigger, smaller - in everyday choices.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real quantities together throughout the day: which plate has more?

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca el número más grande (o más pequeño).
es.audio_text: ¿Cuál es más pequeño, 17 o 71?
hints: Compara la cifra de las decenas: ¿1 o 7?
es.worked_example: Ten ambos números en mente. ¿Cuál llegaría después si contaras?

feedback.correct: 17. Distinguido correctamente de su gemelo invertido. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Estos dos usan las mismas cifras en un orden diferente. Compara la cifra de las decenas.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute. Touche le nombre plus grand (ou plus petit).
fr.audio_text: Lequel est plus petit, 17 ou 71 ?
hints: Compare le chiffre des dizaines : 1 ou 7 ?
fr.worked_example: Garde les deux nombres en tête. Lequel viendrait plus tard si tu comptais ?

feedback.correct: 17. Bien distingué de son jumeau inversé. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Ces deux nombres utilisent les mêmes chiffres dans un ordre différent. Compare le chiffre des dizaines.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. Toque no número maior (ou menor).
pt.audio_text: Qual é menor, 17 ou 71?
hints: Compare o algarismo das dezenas: 1 ou 7?
pt.worked_example: Mantenha os dois números em mente. Qual deles viria depois se você contasse?

feedback.correct: 17. Diferenciado corretamente do seu par invertido. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Esses dois usam os mesmos algarismos em ordem diferente. Compare o algarismo das dezenas.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca il numero più grande (o più piccolo).
it.audio_text: Qual è più piccolo, 17 o 71?
hints: Confronta la cifra delle decine: 1 o 7?
it.worked_example: Tieni a mente entrambi i numeri. Quale verrebbe dopo se contassi?

feedback.correct: 17. Distinto correttamente dal suo gemello invertito. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Questi due usano le stesse cifre in ordine diverso. Confronta la cifra delle decine.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die größere (oder kleinere) Zahl.
de.audio_text: Was ist kleiner, 17 oder 71?
hints: Vergleiche die Zehnerstelle: 1 oder 7?
de.worked_example: Behalte beide Zahlen im Kopf. Welche käme beim Zählen später?

feedback.correct: 17. Richtig von ihrem vertauschten Zwilling unterschieden. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Diese beiden verwenden dieselben Ziffern in anderer Reihenfolge. Vergleiche die Zehnerstelle.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het grotere (of kleinere) getal.
nl.audio_text: Wat is kleiner, 17 of 71?
hints: Vergelijk het tiental: 1 of 7?
nl.worked_example: Houd beide getallen in gedachten. Welke zou je later tegenkomen als je telde?

feedback.correct: 17. Juist onderscheiden van zijn omgedraaide tweeling. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Deze twee gebruiken dezelfde cijfers in een andere volgorde. Vergelijk het tiental.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Послушай. Нажми на большее (или меньшее) число.
hints: Сравни цифру десятков: 1 или 7?
ru.worked_example: Держи оба числа в уме. Какое из них ты назовёшь позже, если будешь считать?

feedback.correct: 17. Ты верно отличил его от перевёрнутого близнеца. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Эти два числа состоят из одних и тех же цифр, но в другом порядке. Сравни цифру десятков.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Hangisi daha küçük, 17 mi 71 mi?
hints: Onlar basamağını karşılaştır: 1 mi 7 mi?
tr.worked_example: Her iki sayıyı da aklında tut. Sayarken hangisine daha sonra ulaşırsın?

feedback.correct: 17. Ters çevrilmiş ikizinden doğru şekilde ayırt edildi. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Bu ikisi aynı rakamları farklı bir sırada kullanıyor. Onlar basamağını karşılaştır.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.instruction: 听。点击较大(或较小)的数字。
zh.audio_text: 17和71,哪个更小?
hints: 比较十位数字:1还是7?
zh.worked_example: 把两个数字都记在心里。如果你数数,哪个会数到更晚?

feedback.correct: 17。正确分辨出了它颠倒的"孪生"数字。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 这两个数字用了相同的数字,顺序不同。比较十位数字。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。大きい(または小さい)数字をタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 17と71、どちらが小さいかな?
hints: 十の位を比べよう:1か7?
ja.worked_example: 両方の数字を頭に入れよう。数えたとき、どちらが後に出てくるかな?

feedback.correct: 17。数字を入れ替えた数ときちんと見分けられたね。🔢
feedback.incorrect: これは同じ数字を違う順番で使っているよ。十の位を比べよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 들어보세요. 더 큰(또는 더 작은) 수를 누르세요.
ko.audio_text: 17과 71 중 어느 것이 더 작을까요?
hints: 십의 자리 숫자를 비교하세요: 1일까요, 7일까요?
ko.worked_example: 두 숫자를 머릿속에 떠올려 보세요. 세어 나갈 때 어느 것이 더 나중에 나올까요?

feedback.correct: 17. 숫자가 뒤집힌 짝과 잘 구별했어요. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 이 두 수는 같은 숫자를 다른 순서로 써요. 십의 자리 숫자를 비교하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan. Sentuh angka yang lebih besar (atau lebih kecil).
id.audio_text: Mana yang lebih kecil, 17 atau 71?
hints: Bandingkan angka puluhannya: 1 atau 7?
id.worked_example: Ingat kedua angka itu. Mana yang akan muncul lebih belakang jika kamu menghitung?

feedback.correct: 17. Berhasil dibedakan dari kembarannya yang terbalik. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Kedua angka ini memakai digit yang sama dengan urutan berbeda. Bandingkan angka puluhannya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào số lớn hơn (hoặc nhỏ hơn).
vi.audio_text: Số nào nhỏ hơn, 17 hay 71?
hints: So sánh chữ số hàng chục: 1 hay 7?
vi.worked_example: Giữ cả hai số trong đầu. Số nào đến sau nếu em đếm?

feedback.correct: 17. Phân biệt đúng với số đảo ngược của nó. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Hai số này dùng cùng các chữ số nhưng theo thứ tự khác. So sánh chữ số hàng chục.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the bigger (or smaller) number.
questions.audio_text: Which is bigger, half of 10 or a quarter of 20?

distractor_insight.half of 10: correctly computed but didn't compare to the other value
distractor_insight.a quarter of 20: correctly computed but didn't compare to the other value

hints: Work out both amounts before comparing.
questions.worked_example: Hold both numbers in mind. Which one would come later if you counted?

feedback.correct: Tied! Both equal 5 - a nice surprise. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Work out each one first: half of ten, and a quarter of twenty.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comparing two spoken quantities

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Sometimes two different-looking calculations land on exactly the same answer.

analysis.primary_construct: holding two heard numbers in mind and comparing their size
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Requires holding both numbers simultaneously, a genuine working-memory step beyond single-number recall.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking the number said second (recency) rather than the mathematically larger one shows memory load, not comparison error.

feedback.incorrect: Tính từng giá trị trước: một nửa của mười, và một phần tư của hai mươi.

zh.instruction: 听。点击较大(或较小)的数字。

feedback.incorrect: まず6の2倍と9の2倍を計算して、それから比べよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to the pattern. Tap what comes next.
questions.audio_text: 1, 2, 3, what comes next?

distractor_insight.3: repeated the last number instead of continuing
distractor_insight.5: skipped a step in the pattern

hints: Each number goes up by one.
questions.worked_example: What's the rule? Add it once more to find the next number.

feedback.correct: 4. The pattern continues by one each time. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Each step adds one. What's one more than three?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: extending a simple spoken number pattern

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Patterns are everywhere - noticing them helps you predict what's next.

analysis.primary_construct: identifying and extending a rule from a short spoken sequence
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Early algebraic reasoning - spotting a rule and predicting forward, a skill that scales to all later maths.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Continuing with a plausible-but-wrong step (adding a different amount) shows the pattern was partly, not fully, understood.
analysis.parent_note: Pattern spotting is the seed of algebra, years before the word algebra ever appears.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Build simple patterns together with objects, then ask what comes next before checking.

es.instruction: Escucha el patrón. Toca lo que viene después.
es.audio_text: 1, 2, 3, ¿qué viene después?
hints: Cada número sube de uno en uno.
es.worked_example: ¿Cuál es la regla? Aplícala una vez más para encontrar el siguiente número.

feedback.correct: 4. El patrón continúa sumando uno cada vez. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Cada paso suma uno. ¿Qué es uno más que tres?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute la suite. Touche ce qui vient après.
fr.audio_text: 1, 2, 3, qu'est-ce qui vient après ?
hints: Chaque nombre augmente de un.
fr.worked_example: Quelle est la règle ? Applique-la une fois de plus pour trouver le prochain nombre.

feedback.correct: 4. La suite continue de un en un. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Chaque étape ajoute un. Qu'est-ce qui fait un de plus que trois ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça o padrão. Toque no que vem a seguir.
pt.audio_text: 1, 2, 3, o que vem a seguir?
hints: Cada número aumenta em um.

feedback.incorrect: Cada passo soma um. O que é um mais que três?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta la sequenza. Tocca cosa viene dopo.
it.audio_text: 1, 2, 3, cosa viene dopo?
hints: Ogni numero aumenta di uno.
it.worked_example: Qual è la regola? Applicala ancora una volta per trovare il numero successivo.

feedback.correct: 4. La sequenza continua di uno ogni volta. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Ogni passo aggiunge uno. Cosa viene dopo tre più uno?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.audio_text: 1, 2, 3, was kommt als Nächstes?
hints: Jede Zahl steigt um eins.

feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

hints: Ogni numero diminuisce di cinque.
it.worked_example: Qual è la regola? Applicala ancora una volta per trovare il numero successivo.

feedback.correct: 5. Contando all'indietro di cinque, continuato correttamente. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Ogni passo diminuisce di cinque. Quanto fa dieci meno cinque?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre dir das Muster an. Tippe, was als Nächstes kommt.
de.audio_text: 20, 15, 10, was kommt als Nächstes?
hints: Jede Zahl sinkt um fünf.
de.worked_example: Was ist die Regel? Wende sie noch einmal an, um die nächste Zahl zu finden.

feedback.correct: 5. Richtig in Fünferschritten rückwärts gezählt. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Jeder Schritt sinkt um fünf. Was ist fünf weniger als zehn?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar het patroon. Tik op wat er daarna komt.
nl.audio_text: 20, 15, 10, wat komt daarna?
hints: Elk getal gaat vijf omlaag.
nl.worked_example: Wat is de regel? Pas hem nog eens toe om het volgende getal te vinden.

feedback.correct: 5. Steeds vijf omlaag, juist doorgezet. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Elke stap gaat vijf naar beneden. Wat is vijf minder dan tien?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Послушай последовательность. Нажми на то, что идёт дальше.
hints: Каждое число уменьшается на пять.
ru.worked_example: Какое правило? Примени его ещё раз, чтобы найти следующее число.

feedback.correct: 5. Счёт назад по пять — продолжено верно. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Каждый шаг уменьшает на пять. Сколько будет десять минус пять?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: 20, 15, 10, sırada ne gelir?
hints: Her sayı beşer beşer azalıyor.
tr.worked_example: Kural nedir? Sıradaki sayıyı bulmak için bir kez daha uygula.

feedback.correct: 5. Beşer beşer geriye doğru sayıldı. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Her adımda beş azalıyor. Ondan beş azı nedir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.instruction: 听这个数列。点击接下来的数字。
hints: 每个数字都比前一个少5。
zh.worked_example: 规律是什么?再应用一次,找出下一个数字。

feedback.correct: 5。每次减5,正确延续了数列。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 每一步减5。比10少5是多少?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: パターンを聞こう。次に来るものをタップしよう。
hints: 数字は5つずつ減っているよ。
ja.worked_example: 法則は何かな?もう一度それを使って、次の数字を見つけよう。

feedback.correct: 5。5つずつ減るパターンを正しく続けられたね。🔢

ko.instruction: 규칙을 들어보세요. 다음에 올 것을 누르세요.

feedback.correct: 5. 다섯씩 거꾸로 세는 규칙을 정확히 이어갔어요. 🔢

id.instruction: Dengarkan polanya. Sentuh yang muncul selanjutnya.
id.audio_text: 20, 15, 10, apa yang muncul selanjutnya?
hints: Setiap angka turun lima.
id.worked_example: Apa aturannya? Terapkan sekali lagi untuk menemukan angka selanjutnya.

feedback.correct: 5. Menghitung mundur lima-lima, berhasil dilanjutkan dengan benar. 🔢

hints: Mỗi số giảm đi năm.
vi.worked_example: Quy luật là gì? Cộng thêm một lần nữa để tìm số tiếp theo.

feedback.correct: 5. Đếm lùi theo năm, tiếp tục đúng rồi. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Mỗi bước giảm đi năm. Mười trừ năm là mấy?

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to the pattern. Tap what comes next.
questions.audio_text: 1, 3, 5, what comes next?

distractor_insight.6: switched from adding two to adding one

hints: Each odd number goes up by two.
questions.worked_example: What's the rule? Add it once more to find the next number.

feedback.correct: 7. The next odd number, correctly continued. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Each step adds two. What's two more than five?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: extending a simple spoken number pattern

life_skill.hidden_lesson: This pattern is all the odd numbers - none of them divide evenly by two.

analysis.primary_construct: identifying and extending a rule from a short spoken sequence
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Early algebraic reasoning - spotting a rule and predicting forward, a skill that scales to all later maths.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Continuing with a plausible-but-wrong step (adding a different amount) shows the pattern was partly, not fully, understood.
analysis.parent_note: Pattern spotting is the seed of algebra, years before the word algebra ever appears.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Build simple patterns together with objects, then ask what comes next before checking.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to the count. Tap what comes next.

hints: Add two more to six.

analysis.primary_construct: extending a skip-counting sequence heard aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Skip counting is the direct precursor to multiplication and a strong predictor of later maths fluency.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Reverting to counting by ones instead of the pattern shown suggests the skip-count rule itself, not just this instance, needs more practice.
analysis.parent_note: Skip counting now saves real effort in multiplication tables later.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice skip counting together during everyday moments - stairs, claps, steps.

analysis.primary_construct: extending a skip-counting sequence heard aloud
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Skip counting is the direct precursor to multiplication and a strong predictor of later maths fluency.

analysis.parent_note: Skip counting now saves real effort in multiplication tables later.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice skip counting together during everyday moments - stairs, claps, steps.

analysis.primary_construct: extracting the needed numbers from a short spoken story and calculating

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen carefully. It has two steps.
questions.audio_text: Ana has 10 coins. She spends 3 on a toy and 2 on a snack. How many coins are left?

distractor_insight.8: only subtracted one of the two amounts
distractor_insight.15: added the amounts spent instead of subtracting them

hints: Take away the toy cost, then take away the snack cost too.
questions.worked_example: Solve the first part. Hold that answer. Now use it for the second part.

feedback.correct: 5. Both amounts taken away correctly, step by step. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: First take away 3, then take away 2 more from that answer.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: solving a two-step word problem heard aloud

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Tracking two spends in a row is exactly how real budgeting works.

analysis.primary_construct: holding an intermediate result in mind while solving a second step
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: A genuine leap in working-memory load - the first result must be held while a second calculation runs.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering with just the first step's result (stopping early) is a working-memory signature, not a maths-concept error.
analysis.parent_note: This is where working memory becomes the real bottleneck, more than the maths itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Break two-step problems into two visibly separate questions at first, then combine them.

questions.audio_text: A jar has 18 sweets. 6 friends each take one, then 3 more are added. How many sweets now?

distractor_insight.12: forgot to add the 3 sweets added back
distractor_insight.27: added everything instead of subtracting the sweets taken

hints: Take away 6 first, then add 3 to that answer.
questions.worked_example: Solve the first part. Hold that answer. Now use it for the second part.

feedback.correct: 15. Both steps done correctly, in order. 🍬
feedback.incorrect: Do it in two steps: 18-6 first, then add 3.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: solving a two-step word problem heard aloud

life_skill.primary: Fair sharing with a changing total
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Sharing fairly among several people, then restocking, is a common real-life pattern.

analysis.primary_construct: holding an intermediate result in mind while solving a second step
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: A genuine leap in working-memory load - the first result must be held while a second calculation runs.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Answering with just the first step's result (stopping early) is a working-memory signature, not a maths-concept error.
analysis.parent_note: This is where working memory becomes the real bottleneck, more than the maths itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Break two-step problems into two visibly separate questions at first, then combine them.

feedback.incorrect: Hazlo en dos pasos: primero 18-6, luego suma 3.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

feedback.incorrect: Сначала отними 45, потом отними ещё 15 от этого результата.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Bir okulda 120 öğrenci var. 45'i geziye gidiyor, 15'i de hasta olduğu için evde kalıyor. Okulda hâlâ kaç öğrenci var?

feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan dengan teliti. Ini punya dua langkah.

feedback.incorrect: Kurangi dulu 45, lalu kurangi lagi 15 dari hasilnya.

feedback.incorrect: Trước tiên bớt đi 45, rồi bớt tiếp 15 nữa từ kết quả đó.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: You have a 5p coin and a 5p coin. How much do you have?

distractor_insight.15p: added an extra 5p that wasn't there

hints: Five plus five.

feedback.correct: 10p. Both coins, correctly added. 🪙

academic.skill: applying number sense to money or time

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Knowing coin values by heart makes shopping much faster.

analysis.primary_construct: using coin values or clock positions heard aloud to answer a question
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Connects abstract number sense to two of the most immediately useful real-world number systems.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing coin values (treating all coins as equal) is a distinct, correctable misconception worth flagging clearly.
analysis.parent_note: Money and time are maths a child uses independently within the year, often before school requires it.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Let your child handle real coins or check a real clock during the question.

feedback.incorrect: Cộng giá trị của hai đồng xu lại: 5 và 5.

distractor_insight.2 hours: miscounted the gap between the two times
distractor_insight.9 hours: used the starting hour number as the gap

hints: Count the hours between 8 and 9.
questions.worked_example: Picture the coins or the clock. What does the question actually ask for?

feedback.correct: 1 hour. Correctly counted the gap. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: How many hours pass between eight o'clock and nine o'clock?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: applying number sense to money or time

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Knowing how much time you have left helps you plan your morning.

analysis.primary_construct: using coin values or clock positions heard aloud to answer a question
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Connects abstract number sense to two of the most immediately useful real-world number systems.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing coin values (treating all coins as equal) is a distinct, correctable misconception worth flagging clearly.
analysis.parent_note: Money and time are maths a child uses independently within the year, often before school requires it.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Let your child handle real coins or check a real clock during the question.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: La escuela empieza a las 9 en punto. Ahora son las 8 en punto. ¿Cuántas horas faltan para que empiece la escuela?
hints: Cuenta las horas entre las 8 y las 9.
es.worked_example: Imagina las monedas o el reloj. ¿Qué pide realmente la pregunta?

feedback.correct: 1 hora. La diferencia contada correctamente. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: ¿Cuántas horas pasan entre las ocho en punto y las nueve en punto?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: L'école commence à 9 heures. Il est maintenant 8 heures. Combien d'heures avant que l'école commence ?
hints: Compte les heures entre 8 et 9.
fr.worked_example: Imagine les pièces ou l'horloge. Que demande vraiment la question ?

feedback.correct: 1 heure. L'écart bien compté. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Combien d'heures passent entre huit heures et neuf heures ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: A escola começa às 9 horas. Agora são 8 horas. Quantas horas faltam até a escola começar?
hints: Conte as horas entre 8 e 9.
pt.worked_example: Imagine as moedas ou o relógio. O que a pergunta realmente pede?

feedback.correct: 1 hora. O intervalo contado corretamente. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Quantas horas passam entre as oito horas e as nove horas?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: La scuola inizia alle 9. Ora sono le 8. Quante ore restano all'inizio della scuola?
hints: Conta le ore tra le 8 e le 9.
it.worked_example: Immagina le monete o l'orologio. Cosa chiede davvero la domanda?

feedback.correct: 1 ora. Intervallo contato correttamente. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Quante ore passano tra le otto e le nove?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Die Schule beginnt um 9 Uhr. Es ist jetzt 8 Uhr. Wie viele Stunden bleiben bis die Schule beginnt?
hints: Zähle die Stunden zwischen 8 und 9.
de.worked_example: Stell dir die Münzen oder die Uhr vor. Was wird in der Frage eigentlich gesucht?

feedback.correct: 1 Stunde. Die Lücke richtig gezählt. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Wie viele Stunden liegen zwischen acht Uhr und neun Uhr?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: School begint om 9 uur. Het is nu 8 uur. Hoeveel uur nog tot school begint?
hints: Tel de uren tussen 8 en 9.
nl.worked_example: Stel je de munten of de klok voor. Wat vraagt de vraag eigenlijk?

feedback.correct: 1 uur. Het verschil juist geteld. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Hoeveel uur zit er tussen acht uur en negen uur?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Школа начинается в 9 часов. Сейчас 8 часов. Сколько часов осталось до начала школы?
hints: Посчитай часы между 8 и 9.
ru.worked_example: Представь монеты или часы. Что именно спрашивают в вопросе?

feedback.correct: 1 час. Промежуток посчитан верно. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Сколько часов проходит между восемью и девятью часами?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Okul saat 9'da başlıyor. Şu an saat 8. Okul başlamasına kaç saat var?
hints: 8 ile 9 arasındaki saatleri say.
tr.worked_example: Paraları veya saati gözünde canlandır. Soru gerçekte neyi soruyor?

feedback.correct: 1 saat. Aradaki fark doğru şekilde sayıldı. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Saat sekiz ile dokuz arasında kaç saat geçer?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.audio_text: 学校9点开始上课。现在是8点。还要多少小时才开始上课?
hints: 数一数8点到9点之间有多少小时。
zh.worked_example: 想象硬币或时钟。这个问题到底在问什么?

feedback.correct: 1小时。正确数出了时间差。🕐
feedback.incorrect: 8点到9点之间过了多少小时?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 学校は9時に始まります。今は8時です。学校が始まるまで何時間かな?
hints: 8時と9時の間の時間を数えよう。
ja.worked_example: コインや時計を思い浮かべよう。問題は本当は何を聞いているかな?

feedback.correct: 1時間。差を正しく数えられたね。🕐
feedback.incorrect: 8時から9時まで何時間かな?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 학교는 9시에 시작해요. 지금은 8시예요. 학교가 시작하기까지 몇 시간 남았을까요?
hints: 8시와 9시 사이의 시간을 세어 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 동전이나 시계를 떠올려 보세요. 질문이 실제로 무엇을 묻고 있나요?

feedback.correct: 1시간. 그 사이 시간을 정확히 세었어요. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: 8시와 9시 사이엔 몇 시간이 지날까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Sekolah dimulai pukul 9. Sekarang pukul 8. Berapa jam lagi sampai sekolah dimulai?
hints: Hitung jam antara pukul 8 dan pukul 9.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan koinnya atau jamnya. Apa sebenarnya yang ditanyakan soal ini?

feedback.correct: 1 jam. Berhasil menghitung selisihnya dengan benar. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Berapa jam yang berlalu antara pukul delapan dan pukul sembilan?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Trường học bắt đầu lúc 9 giờ. Bây giờ là 8 giờ. Còn bao nhiêu giờ nữa thì vào học?
hints: Đếm số giờ giữa 8 và 9.
vi.worked_example: Hình dung các đồng tiền hoặc đồng hồ. Câu hỏi thực sự muốn hỏi điều gì?

feedback.correct: 1 giờ. Đếm đúng khoảng cách rồi. 🕐
feedback.incorrect: Có bao nhiêu giờ trôi qua giữa tám giờ và chín giờ?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: You have two 20p coins and one 5p coin. How much do you have?

hints: 20 plus 20 plus 5.

feedback.incorrect: Add all three coin values: 20, 20, and 5.

questions.audio_text: A film starts at 4 o'clock and lasts 2 hours. What time does it end?

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.

academic.skill: applying number sense to money or time

analysis.primary_construct: using coin values or clock positions heard aloud to answer a question
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Connects abstract number sense to two of the most immediately useful real-world number systems.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.

feedback.correct: 75p. Las cinco monedas, sumadas correctamente. 🪙

hints: 20+20+20+10+5 - additionne-les une à une.

questions.audio_text: A train leaves at 2 o'clock and the journey takes 3 hours. What time does it arrive?

feedback.incorrect: Add the journey length onto the start time: 2 plus 3 hours.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: A pencil is shorter than a ruler. Which is longer?
hints: Shorter means smaller - so the other one is longer.
questions.worked_example: Picture the two things side by side. Which word matches what you hear?

feedback.correct: Ruler. Correctly reasoned from the clue given. 📏
feedback.incorrect: If the pencil is shorter, which one must be longer?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comparing lengths, weights, or capacities described aloud

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Comparison words like shorter and longer always come in matching pairs.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about relative measurement from a spoken description
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Measurement vocabulary (taller, heavier, more) used without a ruler builds intuitive quantity sense first.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing bigger with heavier (assuming large always means heavy) is a specific and common early-measurement misconception.
analysis.parent_note: This is the vocabulary of comparison, used constantly, well before formal units like centimetres matter.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real objects together and use the words taller, heavier, fuller out loud.

feedback.correct: Lapin. Bien raisonné à partir de l'indice donné. 🐇
feedback.incorrect: Si l'escargot se déplace plus lentement, lequel doit aller plus vite ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Um caracol se move mais lentamente que um coelho. Qual se move mais rápido?
hints: Mais lento significa menos velocidade - então o outro se move mais rápido.

feedback.incorrect: Se o caracol se move mais lentamente, qual deve se mover mais rápido?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

feedback.correct: Coniglio. Ragionato correttamente dall'indizio dato. 🐇
feedback.incorrect: Se la lumaca si muove più lentamente, quale deve muoversi più velocemente?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.

hints: Langsamer bedeutet weniger Geschwindigkeit - also bewegt sich das andere schneller.

feedback.incorrect: Wenn sich die Schnecke langsamer bewegt, welches muss sich dann schneller bewegen?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

feedback.incorrect: Als de slak langzamer beweegt, welke moet dan sneller bewegen?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

hints: Медленнее значит меньше скорость — значит, другой двигается быстрее.

feedback.incorrect: Если улитка двигается медленнее, кто должен двигаться быстрее?

tr.audio_text: Bir salyangoz bir tavşandan daha yavaş hareket eder. Hangisi daha hızlı hareket eder?
hints: Daha yavaş, daha az hız demektir - yani diğeri daha hızlı hareket eder.

zh.audio_text: 蜗牛比兔子移动得慢。哪个移动得更快?

feedback.incorrect: 如果蜗牛移动得更慢,那哪个一定移动得更快?

hints: 느리다는 건 속도가 더 작다는 뜻이에요 - 그러니 다른 하나가 더 빠르게 움직여요.

feedback.incorrect: 달팽이가 더 느리게 움직인다면, 어느 것이 더 빠르게 움직여야 할까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

feedback.correct: Kelinci. Berhasil bernalar dengan benar dari petunjuk yang diberikan. 🐇
feedback.incorrect: Jika siput bergerak lebih lambat, mana yang pasti bergerak lebih cepat?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

feedback.incorrect: Nếu con sên di chuyển chậm hơn, con nào chắc chắn phải di chuyển nhanh hơn?

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: A giraffe is taller than a dog, and a dog is taller than a mouse. Which is shortest?

distractor_insight.dog: only compared the middle item, not the whole chain

hints: Follow the chain from tallest to shortest.
questions.worked_example: Picture the two things side by side. Which word matches what you hear?

feedback.correct: Mouse. The whole chain reasoned correctly. 🦒
feedback.incorrect: Follow the chain: giraffe > dog > mouse. Which is at the bottom?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comparing lengths, weights, or capacities described aloud

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Chaining several comparisons together is a real reasoning skill, not just memory.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about relative measurement from a spoken description
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Measurement vocabulary (taller, heavier, more) used without a ruler builds intuitive quantity sense first.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing bigger with heavier (assuming large always means heavy) is a specific and common early-measurement misconception.
analysis.parent_note: This is the vocabulary of comparison, used constantly, well before formal units like centimetres matter.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real objects together and use the words taller, heavier, fuller out loud.

ja.worked_example: 2つのものを並べて思い浮かべよう。聞いたことに合う言葉はどれかな?

feedback.correct: レンガ。全体の順番を正しく考えられたね。🧱
feedback.incorrect: 順番をたどろう:羽<本<レンガ。一番上にあるのは?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 깃털은 책보다 가볍고, 책은 벽돌보다 가벼워요. 어느 것이 가장 무거울까요?
hints: 가장 가벼운 것부터 가장 무거운 것까지 순서를 따라가 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 두 가지를 나란히 놓고 떠올려 보세요. 어떤 말이 들은 내용과 맞을까요?

feedback.correct: 벽돌. 전체 순서를 정확히 생각해냈어요. 🧱
feedback.incorrect: 순서를 따라가 보세요: 깃털 < 책 < 벽돌. 가장 위는 무엇일까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Bulu lebih ringan dari buku, dan buku lebih ringan dari bata. Mana yang paling berat?
hints: Ikuti urutannya dari yang paling ringan ke yang paling berat.
id.worked_example: Bayangkan kedua benda itu berdampingan. Kata mana yang sesuai dengan yang kamu dengar?

feedback.correct: Bata. Seluruh urutan berhasil dinalar dengan benar. 🧱
feedback.incorrect: Ikuti urutannya: bulu < buku < bata. Mana yang paling atas?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Cái lông chim nhẹ hơn cuốn sách, và cuốn sách nhẹ hơn cục gạch. Vật nào nặng nhất?
hints: Theo dõi chuỗi từ nhẹ nhất đến nặng nhất.
vi.worked_example: Hình dung hai vật đặt cạnh nhau. Từ nào khớp với điều em nghe?

feedback.correct: Cục gạch. Suy luận đúng cả chuỗi. 🧱
feedback.incorrect: Theo dõi chuỗi: lông chim < sách < gạch. Vật nào ở trên cùng?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: Bottle A holds more than Bottle B. Bottle B holds more than Bottle C. Which holds the least?

distractor_insight.Bottle B: only compared the middle item, not the whole chain

hints: Follow the chain from most to least.
questions.worked_example: Picture the two things side by side. Which word matches what you hear?

feedback.correct: Bottle C. The whole chain reasoned correctly. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Follow the chain: A > B > C. Which holds the least?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comparing lengths, weights, or capacities described aloud

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Ordering three things by a chain of clues is real logical reasoning.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about relative measurement from a spoken description
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Measurement vocabulary (taller, heavier, more) used without a ruler builds intuitive quantity sense first.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing bigger with heavier (assuming large always means heavy) is a specific and common early-measurement misconception.
analysis.parent_note: This is the vocabulary of comparison, used constantly, well before formal units like centimetres matter.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real objects together and use the words taller, heavier, fuller out loud.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: La Botella A contiene más que la Botella B. La Botella B contiene más que la Botella C. ¿Cuál contiene menos?
hints: Sigue la cadena del que más contiene al que menos contiene.
es.worked_example: Imagina las dos cosas una junto a la otra. ¿Qué palabra coincide con lo que oyes?

feedback.correct: Botella C. Toda la cadena razonada correctamente. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Sigue la cadena: A > B > C. ¿Cuál contiene menos?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: La bouteille A contient plus que la bouteille B. La bouteille B contient plus que la bouteille C. Laquelle contient le moins ?
hints: Suis la chaîne du plus au moins.
fr.worked_example: Imagine les deux objets côte à côte. Quel mot correspond à ce que tu entends ?

feedback.correct: Bouteille C. Toute la chaîne bien raisonnée. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Suis la chaîne : A > B > C. Laquelle contient le moins ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: A Garrafa A contém mais que a Garrafa B. A Garrafa B contém mais que a Garrafa C. Qual contém menos?
hints: Siga a cadeia do que contém mais ao que contém menos.
pt.worked_example: Imagine as duas coisas lado a lado. Qual palavra combina com o que você ouve?

feedback.correct: Garrafa C. Toda a cadeia raciocinada corretamente. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Siga a cadeia: A > B > C. Qual contém menos?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: La Bottiglia A contiene più della Bottiglia B. La Bottiglia B contiene più della Bottiglia C. Quale contiene di meno?
hints: Segui la catena dal più al meno.
it.worked_example: Immagina le due cose fianco a fianco. Quale parola corrisponde a quello che senti?

feedback.correct: Bottiglia C. Tutta la catena ragionata correttamente. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Segui la catena: A > B > C. Quale contiene di meno?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Flasche A fasst mehr als Flasche B. Flasche B fasst mehr als Flasche C. Welche fasst am wenigsten?
hints: Folge der Kette vom meisten zum wenigsten.
de.worked_example: Stell dir die beiden Dinge nebeneinander vor. Welches Wort passt zu dem, was du hörst?

feedback.correct: Flasche C. Die ganze Kette richtig durchdacht. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Folge der Kette: A > B > C. Welche fasst am wenigsten?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Fles A bevat meer dan fles B. Fles B bevat meer dan fles C. Welke bevat het minst?
hints: Volg de keten van meest naar minst.
nl.worked_example: Stel je de twee dingen naast elkaar voor. Welk woord past bij wat je hoort?

feedback.correct: Fles C. De hele keten juist geredeneerd. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Volg de keten: A > B > C. Welke bevat het minst?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: В бутылку A входит больше, чем в бутылку B. В бутылку B входит больше, чем в бутылку C. В какую входит меньше всего?
hints: Следуй по цепочке от самого большого объёма к самому маленькому.
ru.worked_example: Представь два предмета рядом. Какое слово подходит к тому, что ты услышал?

feedback.correct: Бутылка C. Вся цепочка выстроена верно. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Следуй по цепочке: A > B > C. В какую входит меньше всего?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: A Şişesi, B Şişesinden daha fazla alır. B Şişesi, C Şişesinden daha fazla alır. Hangisi en az alır?
hints: En çoktan en aza zinciri takip et.
tr.worked_example: İki şeyi yan yana gözünde canlandır. Duyduğun hangi kelimeyle eşleşiyor?

feedback.correct: C Şişesi. Tüm zincir doğru şekilde çözüldü. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Zinciri takip et: A > B > C. Hangisi en az alır?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.audio_text: 瓶子A装的比瓶子B多。瓶子B装的比瓶子C多。哪个装得最少?
hints: 按照从最多到最少的顺序推理。

feedback.correct: 瓶子C。整条推理链都正确。🍾
feedback.incorrect: 按照这条链:A>B>C。哪个装得最少?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

feedback.correct: ボトルC。全体の順番を正しく考えられたね。🍾
feedback.incorrect: 順番をたどろう:A>B>C。一番少なく入るのは?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 병 A는 병 B보다 많이 담아요. 병 B는 병 C보다 많이 담아요. 어느 것이 가장 적게 담을까요?
hints: 가장 많은 것부터 가장 적은 것까지 순서를 따라가 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 두 가지를 나란히 놓고 떠올려 보세요. 어떤 말이 들은 내용과 맞을까요?

feedback.correct: 병 C. 전체 순서를 정확히 생각해냈어요. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: 순서를 따라가 보세요: A > B > C. 가장 적게 담는 것은 무엇일까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Botol A menampung lebih banyak dari Botol B. Botol B menampung lebih banyak dari Botol C. Mana yang menampung paling sedikit?
hints: Ikuti urutannya dari yang paling banyak ke yang paling sedikit.

feedback.correct: Botol C. Seluruh urutan berhasil dinalar dengan benar. 🍾
feedback.incorrect: Ikuti urutannya: A > B > C. Mana yang paling sedikit?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Bình A chứa nhiều hơn Bình B. Bình B chứa nhiều hơn Bình C. Bình nào chứa ít nhất?
hints: Theo dõi chuỗi từ nhiều nhất đến ít nhất.
