feedback.incorrect: Theo dõi chuỗi: A > B > C. Bình nào chứa ít nhất?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: A big rock is heavier than a small feather pillow. Which is heavier, the rock or the pillow?

distractor_insight.pillow: assumed bigger size always means heavier, ignoring what was actually filled with what

hints: Size alone doesn't decide weight - listen to what's actually said.
questions.worked_example: Picture the two things side by side. Which word matches what you hear?

feedback.correct: Rock. Correctly reasoned, not just guessed from size. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Don't assume from size alone - listen to exactly what was compared.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comparing lengths, weights, or capacities described aloud

life_skill.hidden_lesson: A big object isn't always heavier than a small one - what it's made of matters too.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about relative measurement from a spoken description
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Measurement vocabulary (taller, heavier, more) used without a ruler builds intuitive quantity sense first.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing bigger with heavier (assuming large always means heavy) is a specific and common early-measurement misconception.
analysis.parent_note: This is the vocabulary of comparison, used constantly, well before formal units like centimetres matter.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real objects together and use the words taller, heavier, fuller out loud.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Una piedra grande es más pesada que una pequeña almohada de plumas. ¿Cuál es más pesada, la piedra o la almohada?
hints: El tamaño por sí solo no decide el peso: escucha lo que realmente se dice.
es.worked_example: Imagina las dos cosas una junto a la otra. ¿Qué palabra coincide con lo que oyes?

feedback.correct: Piedra. Razonado correctamente, no solo adivinado por el tamaño. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: No asumas solo por el tamaño: escucha exactamente qué se comparó.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: Un gros rocher est plus lourd qu'un petit oreiller en plumes. Lequel est le plus lourd, le rocher ou l'oreiller ?
hints: La taille seule ne décide pas du poids - écoute ce qui est vraiment dit.
fr.worked_example: Imagine les deux objets côte à côte. Quel mot correspond à ce que tu entends ?

feedback.correct: Rocher. Bien raisonné, pas juste devinée à partir de la taille. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Ne suppose pas à partir de la taille seule - écoute exactement ce qui a été comparé.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Uma pedra grande é mais pesada que um travesseiro de penas pequeno. Qual é mais pesado, a pedra ou o travesseiro?
hints: O tamanho por si só não decide o peso - ouça o que realmente foi dito.
pt.worked_example: Imagine as duas coisas lado a lado. Qual palavra combina com o que você ouve?

feedback.correct: Pedra. Raciocínio correto, não apenas um palpite pelo tamanho. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Não assuma apenas pelo tamanho - ouça exatamente o que foi comparado.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Un grande sasso è più pesante di un piccolo cuscino di piume. Quale è più pesante, il sasso o il cuscino?
hints: La dimensione da sola non decide il peso - ascolta cosa viene detto davvero.
it.worked_example: Immagina le due cose fianco a fianco. Quale parola corrisponde a quello che senti?

feedback.correct: Sasso. Ragionato correttamente, non solo indovinato dalla dimensione. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Non supporre dalla sola dimensione - ascolta esattamente cosa è stato confrontato.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Ein großer Stein ist schwerer als ein kleines Federkissen. Was ist schwerer, der Stein oder das Kissen?
hints: Größe allein entscheidet nicht über das Gewicht - höre genau, was gesagt wird.
de.worked_example: Stell dir die beiden Dinge nebeneinander vor. Welches Wort passt zu dem, was du hörst?

feedback.correct: Stein. Richtig geschlossen, nicht nur aus der Größe geraten. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Nimm nicht nur aufgrund der Größe an - höre genau, was verglichen wurde.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Een grote steen is zwaarder dan een klein verenkussen. Wat is zwaarder, de steen of het kussen?
hints: Grootte alleen bepaalt niet het gewicht - luister naar wat er echt gezegd wordt.
nl.worked_example: Stel je de twee dingen naast elkaar voor. Welk woord past bij wat je hoort?

feedback.correct: Steen. Juist geredeneerd, niet zomaar geraden op grootte. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Ga niet zomaar uit van grootte alleen - luister precies naar wat er vergeleken werd.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Большой камень тяжелее маленькой пуховой подушки. Что тяжелее: камень или подушка?
hints: Размер сам по себе не определяет вес — слушай, что сказано на самом деле.
ru.worked_example: Представь два предмета рядом. Какое слово подходит к тому, что ты услышал?

feedback.correct: Камень. Вывод сделан верно, а не угадан по размеру. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Не делай вывод только по размеру — слушай, что именно сравнивали.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Büyük bir kaya, küçük bir tüy yastıktan daha ağırdır. Hangisi daha ağır, kaya mı yastık mı?
hints: Sadece boyut ağırlığı belirlemez - gerçekte ne söylendiğini dinle.
tr.worked_example: İki şeyi yan yana gözünde canlandır. Duyduğun hangi kelimeyle eşleşiyor?

feedback.correct: Kaya. Sadece boyuttan tahmin edilmedi, doğru şekilde çıkarım yapıldı. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Sadece boyuttan varsayımda bulunma - tam olarak neyin karşılaştırıldığını dinle.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.audio_text: 一块大石头比一个小羽毛枕头重。石头和枕头,哪个更重?
hints: 大小本身不能决定重量——听清楚到底说了什么。
zh.worked_example: 想象这两个东西并排放着。哪个词和你听到的匹配?

feedback.incorrect: 不要只凭大小猜测——仔细听清楚比较的是什么。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 大きな岩は小さな羽の枕より重いです。岩と枕、どちらが重いかな?
hints: 大きさだけでは重さは決まらないよ。実際に言われたことを聞こう。
ja.worked_example: 2つのものを並べて思い浮かべよう。聞いたことに合う言葉はどれかな?

feedback.correct: 岩。大きさだけで当てずに、正しく考えられたね。🪨
feedback.incorrect: 大きさだけで決めないで。実際に比べられたことをよく聞こう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 큰 돌은 작은 깃털 베개보다 무거워요. 돌과 베개 중 어느 것이 더 무거울까요?
hints: 크기만으로 무게를 결정할 수 없어요 - 실제로 들은 말을 생각해 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 두 가지를 나란히 놓고 떠올려 보세요. 어떤 말이 들은 내용과 맞을까요?

feedback.correct: 돌. 크기로 짐작하지 않고 정확히 생각해냈어요. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: 크기만 보고 짐작하지 마세요 - 정확히 무엇을 비교했는지 들어보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Batu besar lebih berat dari bantal bulu yang kecil. Mana yang lebih berat, batu atau bantalnya?

feedback.correct: Batu. Berhasil bernalar dengan benar, bukan hanya menduga dari ukurannya. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Jangan menduga hanya dari ukurannya - dengarkan dengan tepat apa yang dibandingkan.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Một tảng đá to nặng hơn một cái gối lông nhỏ. Vật nào nặng hơn, tảng đá hay cái gối?
hints: Kích thước không quyết định khối lượng - hãy nghe kỹ điều thực sự được nói.

feedback.correct: Tảng đá. Suy luận đúng, không chỉ đoán theo kích thước. 🪨
feedback.incorrect: Đừng chỉ đoán theo kích thước - hãy nghe kỹ những gì được so sánh.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: Container X holds twice as much as Container Y. Container Y holds half as much as Container Z. Which holds the most?
options: It depends - not enough information to be sure
questions.correct_answer: It depends - not enough information to be sure
accepted_answers: It depends - not enough information to be sure

distractor_insight.Container X: assumed X was largest without checking Z's exact relationship to X
distractor_insight.Container Z: correct guess but for the wrong structural reason - genuinely ambiguous without a real number

hints: Think carefully - do we actually know enough to be sure?
questions.worked_example: Picture the two things side by side. Which word matches what you hear?

feedback.correct: Careful thinking - without a real starting number, we truly can't be certain which is biggest here. 🪣
feedback.incorrect: This one's genuinely tricky - try working out actual amounts with a starting number.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comparing lengths, weights, or capacities described aloud

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Good mathematicians also notice when a question doesn't give quite enough to be sure.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about relative measurement from a spoken description
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Measurement vocabulary (taller, heavier, more) used without a ruler builds intuitive quantity sense first.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Confusing bigger with heavier (assuming large always means heavy) is a specific and common early-measurement misconception.
analysis.parent_note: This is the vocabulary of comparison, used constantly, well before formal units like centimetres matter.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real objects together and use the words taller, heavier, fuller out loud.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: Two friends share one pizza equally. What fraction does each friend get?

distractor_insight.1/3: used the wrong number of people sharing
distractor_insight.2/2: described the whole, not one person's share

hints: Two people, so split it into two equal parts.
questions.worked_example: If everyone gets the same amount, how many equal parts do you need?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Each friend gets one half. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Two people share it - split into two equal pieces.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: early fraction reasoning through fair sharing

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Half means splitting something into exactly two equal parts.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about equal parts of a whole from a spoken sharing scenario
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Introduces fractions through the intuitive, familiar idea of fair sharing rather than abstract notation.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Choosing unequal-looking pieces as fair shows the concept of equal parts, not just splitting, needs reinforcing.
analysis.parent_note: Fair sharing is a fraction a young child already understands intuitively - this just names it.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice sharing snacks equally between people and naming the fraction out loud.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Dos amigos comparten una pizza por igual. ¿Qué fracción recibe cada amigo?
hints: Dos personas, así que divídela en dos partes iguales.
es.worked_example: Si todos reciben la misma cantidad, ¿cuántas partes iguales necesitas?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Cada amigo recibe una mitad. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Dos personas la comparten: divídela en dos partes iguales.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: Deux amis partagent une pizza à parts égales. Quelle fraction chaque ami reçoit-il ?
hints: Deux personnes, donc divise en deux parts égales.
fr.worked_example: Si tout le monde reçoit la même quantité, combien de parts égales te faut-il ?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Chaque ami reçoit une moitié. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Deux personnes la partagent - divise en deux parts égales.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Dois amigos dividem uma pizza igualmente. Que fração cada amigo recebe?
hints: Duas pessoas, então divida em duas partes iguais.

feedback.correct: 1/2. Cada amigo recebe uma metade. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Duas pessoas dividem - separe em duas partes iguais.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Due amici condividono una pizza in parti uguali. Che frazione riceve ciascun amico?
hints: Due persone, quindi dividila in due parti uguali.

feedback.correct: 1/2. Ogni amico riceve metà. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Due persone la condividono - dividila in due pezzi uguali.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Zwei Freunde teilen sich eine Pizza gleichmäßig. Welchen Anteil bekommt jeder Freund?
hints: Zwei Personen, also teile sie in zwei gleiche Teile.

feedback.correct: 1/2. Jeder Freund bekommt die Hälfte. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Zwei Personen teilen sie sich - in zwei gleiche Stücke aufteilen.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: Four people share 12 grapes equally. How many grapes does each person get?

distractor_insight.4: confused the number of people with the number of grapes each
distractor_insight.12: gave the whole amount instead of one share

hints: Twelve grapes split evenly between four people.
questions.worked_example: If everyone gets the same amount, how many equal parts do you need?

feedback.correct: 3. Twelve shared between four, equally. 🍇
feedback.incorrect: Divide twelve grapes equally between four people.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: early fraction reasoning through fair sharing

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Sharing equally means everyone should have exactly the same amount, not just roughly.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about equal parts of a whole from a spoken sharing scenario
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Introduces fractions through the intuitive, familiar idea of fair sharing rather than abstract notation.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Choosing unequal-looking pieces as fair shows the concept of equal parts, not just splitting, needs reinforcing.
analysis.parent_note: Fair sharing is a fraction a young child already understands intuitively - this just names it.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice sharing snacks equally between people and naming the fraction out loud.

id.audio_text: Mana yang lebih besar, satu setengah atau satu perempat dari pizza yang sama?
hints: Semakin banyak potongan dari pizza yang sama berarti setiap potongannya semakin kecil.
id.worked_example: Jika semua orang mendapat jumlah yang sama, berapa bagian sama besar yang kamu butuhkan?

feedback.correct: Satu setengah. Potongan yang lebih sedikit tapi besar lebih banyak dari potongan yang lebih banyak tapi kecil. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Bayangkan pizza yang sama dipotong menjadi 2 potong dibandingkan 4 potong. Potongan mana yang lebih besar?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Phần nào lớn hơn, một nửa hay một phần tư của cùng một cái bánh pizza?
hints: Càng nhiều phần cắt từ cùng một cái bánh thì mỗi phần càng nhỏ.
vi.worked_example: Nếu mọi người nhận phần bằng nhau, em cần chia thành bao nhiêu phần?

feedback.correct: Một nửa. Ít phần nhưng to hơn sẽ lớn hơn nhiều phần nhưng nhỏ. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Hình dung cùng một cái bánh cắt thành 2 phần so với 4 phần. Phần nào lớn hơn?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: Six friends share 3 pizzas equally. What fraction of a pizza does each friend get?

distractor_insight.1/3: used the number of pizzas instead of doing the actual division
distractor_insight.3/6: left the fraction unsimplified, though the value is the same

hints: Three pizzas among six people - work out the exact share per person.
questions.worked_example: If everyone gets the same amount, how many equal parts do you need?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Three pizzas shared six ways is half a pizza each. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Three pizzas for six people - how much is that per person?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: early fraction reasoning through fair sharing

life_skill.primary: Sharing multiple items among a group
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Sharing several items among a group at once is real fraction reasoning.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about equal parts of a whole from a spoken sharing scenario
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Introduces fractions through the intuitive, familiar idea of fair sharing rather than abstract notation.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Choosing unequal-looking pieces as fair shows the concept of equal parts, not just splitting, needs reinforcing.
analysis.parent_note: Fair sharing is a fraction a young child already understands intuitively - this just names it.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice sharing snacks equally between people and naming the fraction out loud.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Seis amigos comparten 3 pizzas por igual. ¿Qué fracción de una pizza recibe cada amigo?
hints: Tres pizzas entre seis personas: calcula la parte exacta por persona.
es.worked_example: Si todos reciben la misma cantidad, ¿cuántas partes iguales necesitas?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Tres pizzas repartidas entre seis es media pizza cada uno. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Tres pizzas para seis personas: ¿cuánto es eso por persona?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: Six amis partagent 3 pizzas à parts égales. Quelle fraction d'une pizza chaque ami reçoit-il ?
hints: Trois pizzas pour six personnes - calcule la part exacte par personne.
fr.worked_example: Si tout le monde reçoit la même quantité, combien de parts égales te faut-il ?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Trois pizzas partagées en six donne une demi-pizza chacun. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Trois pizzas pour six personnes - combien cela fait-il par personne ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Seis amigos dividem 3 pizzas igualmente. Que fração de uma pizza cada amigo recebe?
hints: Três pizzas entre seis pessoas - calcule a parte exata de cada um.
pt.worked_example: Se todos recebem a mesma quantidade, quantas partes iguais você precisa?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Três pizzas divididas em seis partes é meia pizza para cada um. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Três pizzas para seis pessoas - quanto é isso por pessoa?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Sei amici condividono 3 pizze in parti uguali. Che frazione di pizza riceve ciascun amico?
hints: Tre pizze tra sei persone - calcola la quota esatta per persona.
it.worked_example: Se tutti ricevono la stessa quantità, quante parti uguali servono?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Tre pizze divise in sei parti è metà pizza ciascuno. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Tre pizze per sei persone - quanto corrisponde a testa?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Sechs Freunde teilen sich 3 Pizzen gleichmäßig. Welchen Anteil einer Pizza bekommt jeder Freund?
hints: Drei Pizzen für sechs Personen - rechne den genauen Anteil pro Person aus.
de.worked_example: Wenn alle den gleichen Anteil bekommen, wie viele gleiche Teile brauchst du?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Drei Pizzen auf sechs Personen aufgeteilt ergibt eine halbe Pizza pro Person. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Drei Pizzen für sechs Personen - wie viel ist das pro Person?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Zes vrienden delen 3 pizza's gelijk. Welke breuk van een pizza krijgt elke vriend?
hints: Drie pizza's onder zes personen - werk het precieze aandeel per persoon uit.
nl.worked_example: Als iedereen evenveel krijgt, hoeveel gelijke delen heb je dan nodig?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Drie pizza's verdeeld onder zes is een halve pizza per persoon. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Drie pizza's voor zes personen - hoeveel is dat per persoon?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Шесть друзей делят 3 пиццы поровну. Какую долю пиццы получает каждый друг?
hints: Три пиццы на шесть человек — вычисли точную долю на каждого.
ru.worked_example: Если всем нужно одинаковое количество, на сколько равных частей нужно разделить?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Три пиццы на шесть частей — это половина пиццы каждому. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Три пиццы на шесть человек — сколько это на каждого?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Altı arkadaş 3 pizzayı eşit olarak paylaşıyor. Her arkadaş bir pizzanın kaçta kaçını alır?
hints: Altı kişi arasında üç pizza - kişi başına düşen tam payı hesapla.
tr.worked_example: Herkes aynı miktarı alacaksa, kaç eşit parçaya ihtiyacın var?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Üç pizzanın altı kişiye paylaştırılması kişi başı yarım pizza demektir. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Altı kişi için üç pizza - kişi başına bu ne kadar?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.audio_text: 六个朋友平分3个披萨。每人分到一个披萨的多少分之几?
hints: 3个披萨分给6个人——算出每人确切分到多少。
zh.worked_example: 如果每人分到的一样多,需要分成多少等份?

feedback.correct: 1/2。3个披萨分给6个人,每人分到半个披萨。🍕
feedback.incorrect: 3个披萨给6个人——每人分到多少?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: 友達6人でピザ3枚を等しく分けます。それぞれの友達はどれだけの分数をもらうかな?
hints: 3枚のピザを6人で分けるよ。1人分を正確に計算しよう。
ja.worked_example: みんなが同じ量をもらうなら、何個の等しい部分が必要かな?

feedback.correct: 1/2。3枚のピザを6人で分けると、1人半分だね。🍕
feedback.incorrect: 3枚のピザを6人で。1人分はどれくらいかな?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 친구 여섯 명이 피자 3개를 똑같이 나눠요. 각자 피자의 몇 분의 몇을 받을까요?
hints: 피자 3개를 여섯 명에게 - 한 사람당 정확한 양을 계산해 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 모두가 똑같이 나눠 가진다면, 몇 개의 똑같은 조각이 필요할까요?

feedback.correct: 1/2. 피자 3개를 여섯 명이 나누면 한 사람당 반 개예요. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: 피자 3개를 여섯 명이 나눠요 - 한 사람당 얼마일까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Enam teman membagi 3 pizza secara rata. Berapa pecahan pizza yang didapat masing-masing teman?
hints: Tiga pizza untuk enam orang - hitung bagian pasti untuk setiap orang.
id.worked_example: Jika semua orang mendapat jumlah yang sama, berapa bagian sama besar yang kamu butuhkan?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Tiga pizza dibagi enam cara berarti setengah pizza untuk masing-masing. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Tiga pizza untuk enam orang - berapa itu untuk setiap orang?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Sáu người bạn chia đều 3 cái bánh pizza. Mỗi người được bao nhiêu phần của một cái bánh?
hints: Ba cái bánh cho sáu người - tính chính xác phần mỗi người được.
vi.worked_example: Nếu mọi người nhận phần bằng nhau, em cần chia thành bao nhiêu phần?

feedback.correct: 1/2. Ba cái bánh chia cho sáu người là mỗi người được nửa cái. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Ba cái bánh cho sáu người - mỗi người được bao nhiêu?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to three numbers. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: Listen: seven, two, five. Put them in order from smallest to largest.
hints: Which number would you say first when counting?
questions.worked_example: Say all three numbers to yourself. Which is smallest? Start there.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - correctly ordered. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Think about which number comes first when counting up.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: ordering numbers heard aloud, out of sequence

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Ordering numbers is comparison done three times in a row.

analysis.primary_construct: holding three heard numbers in mind and ranking them
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest working-memory task in the module - three numbers must be held and compared simultaneously, purely from sound.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Ordering correctly but slowly shows real comparison ability limited by memory load, not number sense itself.
analysis.parent_note: Holding three numbers in mind at once, from sound alone, is genuinely demanding - celebrate the attempt.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Start with two numbers before moving to three, building working memory gradually.

es.instruction: Escucha tres números. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Escucha: siete, dos, cinco. Ponlos en orden de menor a mayor.
hints: ¿Qué número dirías primero al contar?
es.worked_example: Dite los tres números a ti mismo. ¿Cuál es el más pequeño? Empieza por ahí.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7: ordenados correctamente. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en qué número viene primero al contar hacia arriba.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute trois nombres. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: Écoute : sept, deux, cinq. Mets-les dans l'ordre du plus petit au plus grand.
hints: Lequel de ces nombres dirais-tu en premier en comptant ?
fr.worked_example: Dis les trois nombres dans ta tête. Lequel est le plus petit ? Commence par là.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - bien ordonnés. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Pense à quel nombre vient en premier en comptant.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça três números. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Ouça: sete, dois, cinco. Coloque-os em ordem do menor ao maior.
hints: Qual número você diria primeiro ao contar?
pt.worked_example: Diga os três números para si mesmo. Qual é o menor? Comece por aí.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - ordenados corretamente. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Pense em qual número vem primeiro ao contar para frente.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta tre numeri. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Ascolta: sette, due, cinque. Mettili in ordine dal più piccolo al più grande.
hints: Quale numero diresti prima contando?
it.worked_example: Dì a te stesso tutti e tre i numeri. Quale è il più piccolo? Inizia da lì.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - ordinati correttamente. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quale numero viene prima contando in ordine crescente.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre dir drei Zahlen an. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Höre zu: sieben, zwei, fünf. Bringe sie in die Reihenfolge von der kleinsten zur größten.
hints: Welche Zahl würdest du beim Zählen zuerst sagen?
de.worked_example: Sprich alle drei Zahlen für dich. Welche ist am kleinsten? Fang dort an.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - richtig angeordnet. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, welche Zahl beim Aufwärtszählen zuerst kommt.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar drie getallen. Zet ze op volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Luister: zeven, twee, vijf. Zet ze op volgorde van kleinste naar grootste.
hints: Welk getal zou je het eerst zeggen bij het tellen?
nl.worked_example: Zeg alle drie de getallen in jezelf. Welke is het kleinst? Begin daar.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - juist geordend. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Denk na over welk getal het eerst komt bij het optellend tellen.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Послушай три числа. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Слушай: семь, два, пять. Расставь их по порядку от самого маленького до самого большого.
hints: Какое число ты назовёшь первым при счёте?
ru.worked_example: Повтори все три числа про себя. Какое самое маленькое? Начни с него.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 — расставлено верно. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, какое число идёт первым при счёте вперёд.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Üç sayıyı dinle. Onları sıraya diz.
tr.audio_text: Dinle: yedi, iki, beş. Onları en küçükten en büyüğe sırala.
hints: Sayarken hangi sayıyı önce söylersin?
tr.worked_example: Üç sayıyı da kendine söyle. Hangisi en küçük? Oradan başla.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - doğru sıralandı. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Sayarken hangi sayının önce geldiğini düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.instruction: 听三个数字。把它们排序。
zh.audio_text: 听:七、二、五。把它们从小到大排序。
hints: 数数时你会先说哪个数字?
zh.worked_example: 自己念一念这三个数字。哪个最小?从那个开始。

feedback.incorrect: 想一想往上数的时候哪个数字先出现。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 3つの数字を聞こう。順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いてみよう:7、2、5。小さい順に並べよう。
hints: どの数字を数えるとき最初に言う?
ja.worked_example: 3つの数字を声に出してみよう。どれが一番小さい?そこから始めよう。

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - 正しく並べられたね。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 数え上げるとき、どの数字が先に来るか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 세 개의 숫자를 들어보세요. 순서대로 놓으세요.
ko.audio_text: 들어보세요: 일곱, 둘, 다섯. 작은 수부터 큰 수 순서로 놓으세요.
hints: 셀 때 어느 숫자를 먼저 말할까요?
ko.worked_example: 세 숫자를 마음속으로 말해 보세요. 어느 것이 가장 작나요? 거기서부터 시작하세요.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - 순서대로 정확히 놓았어요. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 위로 셀 때 어느 숫자가 먼저 나오는지 생각해 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan tiga angka. Urutkan angka-angka itu.
id.audio_text: Dengarkan: tujuh, dua, lima. Urutkan dari yang terkecil ke yang terbesar.
hints: Angka mana yang akan kamu sebut lebih dulu saat menghitung?
id.worked_example: Ucapkan ketiga angka itu dalam hati. Mana yang paling kecil? Mulai dari situ.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - berhasil diurutkan dengan benar. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan angka mana yang muncul lebih dulu saat menghitung naik.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe ba số. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Lắng nghe: bảy, hai, năm. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự từ nhỏ đến lớn.
hints: Số nào em sẽ đọc trước tiên khi đếm?
vi.worked_example: Đọc thầm cả ba số. Số nào nhỏ nhất? Bắt đầu từ đó.

feedback.correct: 2, 5, 7 - sắp xếp đúng rồi. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Nghĩ xem số nào đến trước khi đếm lên.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

feedback.incorrect: Les trois sont dans cette tranche. Compare le dernier chiffre de chacun.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça três números. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Ouça: dezoito, treze, dezesseis. Coloque-os em ordem do menor ao maior.
hints: Os três são números entre dez e dezenove - compare o algarismo das unidades.
pt.worked_example: Diga os três números para si mesmo. Qual é o menor? Comece por aí.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - ordenados corretamente dentro dessa faixa. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Os três estão entre dez e dezenove. Compare o último algarismo de cada um.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta tre numeri. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Ascolta: diciotto, tredici, sedici. Mettili in ordine dal più piccolo al più grande.
hints: Tutti e tre sono numeri dalla decina dei dieci - confronta la cifra delle unità.
it.worked_example: Dì a te stesso tutti e tre i numeri. Quale è il più piccolo? Inizia da lì.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - ordinati correttamente all'interno della decina dei dieci. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Tutti e tre sono nella decina dei dieci. Confronta l'ultima cifra di ognuno.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre dir drei Zahlen an. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Höre zu: achtzehn, dreizehn, sechzehn. Bringe sie in die Reihenfolge von der kleinsten zur größten.
hints: Alle drei sind Zahlen zwischen zehn und zwanzig - vergleiche die Einerstelle.
de.worked_example: Sprich alle drei Zahlen für dich. Welche ist am kleinsten? Fang dort an.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - richtig angeordnet innerhalb der Zehnerzahlen. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Alle drei liegen zwischen zehn und zwanzig. Vergleiche die letzte Ziffer jeder Zahl.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar drie getallen. Zet ze op volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Luister: achttien, dertien, zestien. Zet ze op volgorde van kleinste naar grootste.
hints: Alle drie zijn tienertallen - vergelijk het eenheidscijfer.
nl.worked_example: Zeg alle drie de getallen in jezelf. Welke is het kleinst? Begin daar.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - juist geordend binnen de tienertallen. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Alle drie zijn tienertallen. Vergelijk het laatste cijfer van elk.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Послушай три числа. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Слушай: восемнадцать, тринадцать, шестнадцать. Расставь их по порядку от самого маленького до самого большого.
hints: Все три числа от одиннадцати до девятнадцати — сравни последнюю цифру.
ru.worked_example: Повтори все три числа про себя. Какое самое маленькое? Начни с него.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 — расставлено верно среди чисел второго десятка. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Все три — числа второго десятка. Сравни последнюю цифру каждого.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Üç sayıyı dinle. Onları sıraya diz.
tr.audio_text: Dinle: on sekiz, on üç, on altı. Onları en küçükten en büyüğe sırala.
hints: Üçü de on'lu sayılar - birler basamağını karşılaştır.
tr.worked_example: Üç sayıyı da kendine söyle. Hangisi en küçük? Oradan başla.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - on'lu sayılar içinde doğru sıralandı. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Üçü de on'lu sayılar. Her birinin son basamağını karşılaştır.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.instruction: 听三个数字。把它们排序。
zh.audio_text: 听:十八、十三、十六。把它们从小到大排序。
hints: 这三个都是十几的数——比较个位数字。
zh.worked_example: 自己念一念这三个数字。哪个最小?从那个开始。

feedback.correct: 13、16、18——在十几的范围内排序正确。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 三个都是十几的数。比较每个数字的最后一位。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 3つの数字を聞こう。順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いてみよう:18、13、16。小さい順に並べよう。
hints: 3つとも10代の数字だよ。一の位を比べよう。
ja.worked_example: 3つの数字を声に出してみよう。どれが一番小さい?そこから始めよう。

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - 10代の中で正しく並べられたね。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 3つとも10代だよ。それぞれの最後の桁を比べよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 세 개의 숫자를 들어보세요. 순서대로 놓으세요.
ko.audio_text: 들어보세요: 열여덟, 열셋, 열여섯. 작은 수부터 큰 수 순서로 놓으세요.
hints: 세 수 모두 10대 수예요 - 일의 자리를 비교하세요.
ko.worked_example: 세 숫자를 마음속으로 말해 보세요. 어느 것이 가장 작나요? 거기서부터 시작하세요.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - 10대 수 안에서 순서대로 정확히 놓았어요. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 세 수 모두 10대예요. 각 수의 마지막 숫자를 비교하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan tiga angka. Urutkan angka-angka itu.
id.audio_text: Dengarkan: delapan belas, tiga belas, enam belas. Urutkan dari yang terkecil ke yang terbesar.
hints: Ketiganya adalah bilangan belasan - bandingkan angka satuannya.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan ketiga angka itu dalam hati. Mana yang paling kecil? Mulai dari situ.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - berhasil diurutkan dengan benar di antara bilangan belasan. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Ketiganya bilangan belasan. Bandingkan angka terakhir dari masing-masing.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe ba số. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Lắng nghe: mười tám, mười ba, mười sáu. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự từ nhỏ đến lớn.
hints: Cả ba đều là số mười mấy - so sánh chữ số hàng đơn vị.
vi.worked_example: Đọc thầm cả ba số. Số nào nhỏ nhất? Bắt đầu từ đó.

feedback.correct: 13, 16, 18 - sắp xếp đúng trong nhóm số mười mấy. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Cả ba đều là số mười mấy. So sánh chữ số cuối của mỗi số.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to three numbers. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: Listen: forty-five, twenty-three, thirty-four. Put them in order from smallest to largest.
hints: Compare the tens digit of each: 2, 3, or 4?
questions.worked_example: Say all three numbers to yourself. Which is smallest? Start there.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - correctly ordered across three different tens. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Compare the tens digit of each number to order them.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: ordering numbers heard aloud, out of sequence

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Once numbers span different tens, the tens digit almost always decides the order.

analysis.primary_construct: holding three heard numbers in mind and ranking them
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest working-memory task in the module - three numbers must be held and compared simultaneously, purely from sound.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Ordering correctly but slowly shows real comparison ability limited by memory load, not number sense itself.
analysis.parent_note: Holding three numbers in mind at once, from sound alone, is genuinely demanding - celebrate the attempt.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Start with two numbers before moving to three, building working memory gradually.

es.instruction: Escucha tres números. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Escucha: cuarenta y cinco, veintitrés, treinta y cuatro. Ponlos en orden de menor a mayor.
hints: Compara la cifra de las decenas de cada uno: ¿2, 3 o 4?
es.worked_example: Dite los tres números a ti mismo. ¿Cuál es el más pequeño? Empieza por ahí.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45: ordenados correctamente entre tres decenas diferentes. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Compara la cifra de las decenas de cada número para ordenarlos.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute trois nombres. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: Écoute : quarante-cinq, vingt-trois, trente-quatre. Mets-les dans l'ordre du plus petit au plus grand.
hints: Compare le chiffre des dizaines de chacun : 2, 3, ou 4 ?
fr.worked_example: Dis les trois nombres dans ta tête. Lequel est le plus petit ? Commence par là.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - bien ordonnés sur trois dizaines différentes. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Compare le chiffre des dizaines de chaque nombre pour les ordonner.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça três números. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Ouça: quarenta e cinco, vinte e três, trinta e quatro. Coloque-os em ordem do menor ao maior.
hints: Compare o algarismo das dezenas de cada um: 2, 3 ou 4?
pt.worked_example: Diga os três números para si mesmo. Qual é o menor? Comece por aí.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - ordenados corretamente em três dezenas diferentes. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Compare o algarismo das dezenas de cada número para ordená-los.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta tre numeri. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Ascolta: quarantacinque, ventitré, trentaquattro. Mettili in ordine dal più piccolo al più grande.
hints: Confronta la cifra delle decine di ognuno: 2, 3 o 4?
it.worked_example: Dì a te stesso tutti e tre i numeri. Quale è il più piccolo? Inizia da lì.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - ordinati correttamente tra tre decine diverse. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Confronta la cifra delle decine di ogni numero per ordinarli.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre dir drei Zahlen an. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Höre zu: fünfundvierzig, dreiundzwanzig, vierunddreißig. Bringe sie in die Reihenfolge von der kleinsten zur größten.
hints: Vergleiche die Zehnerstelle jeder Zahl: 2, 3 oder 4?
de.worked_example: Sprich alle drei Zahlen für dich. Welche ist am kleinsten? Fang dort an.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - richtig angeordnet über drei verschiedene Zehner. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Vergleiche die Zehnerstelle jeder Zahl, um sie zu ordnen.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar drie getallen. Zet ze op volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Luister: vijfenveertig, drieëntwintig, vierendertig. Zet ze op volgorde van kleinste naar grootste.
hints: Vergelijk het tiental van elk: 2, 3, of 4?
nl.worked_example: Zeg alle drie de getallen in jezelf. Welke is het kleinst? Begin daar.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - juist geordend over drie verschillende tientallen. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Vergelijk het tiental van elk getal om ze te ordenen.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Послушай три числа. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Слушай: сорок пять, двадцать три, тридцать четыре. Расставь их по порядку от самого маленького до самого большого.
hints: Сравни цифру десятков каждого числа: 2, 3 или 4?
ru.worked_example: Повтори все три числа про себя. Какое самое маленькое? Начни с него.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 — расставлено верно по трём разным десяткам. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Сравни цифру десятков каждого числа, чтобы расставить их по порядку.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Üç sayıyı dinle. Onları sıraya diz.
tr.audio_text: Dinle: kırk beş, yirmi üç, otuz dört. Onları en küçükten en büyüğe sırala.
hints: Her birinin onlar basamağını karşılaştır: 2, 3 mü yoksa 4 mü?
tr.worked_example: Üç sayıyı da kendine söyle. Hangisi en küçük? Oradan başla.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - üç farklı onlar basamağında doğru sıralandı. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Sıralamak için her sayının onlar basamağını karşılaştır.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.instruction: 听三个数字。把它们排序。
zh.audio_text: 听:四十五、二十三、三十四。把它们从小到大排序。
hints: 比较每个数字的十位:2、3还是4?
zh.worked_example: 自己念一念这三个数字。哪个最小?从那个开始。

feedback.correct: 23、34、45——在三个不同的十位数之间排序正确。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 比较每个数字的十位来排序。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 3つの数字を聞こう。順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いてみよう:45、23、34。小さい順に並べよう。
hints: それぞれの十の位を比べよう:2、3、それとも4?
ja.worked_example: 3つの数字を声に出してみよう。どれが一番小さい?そこから始めよう。

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - 3つの違う十の位でも正しく並べられたね。🔢
feedback.incorrect: それぞれの数字の十の位を比べて並べよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 세 개의 숫자를 들어보세요. 순서대로 놓으세요.
ko.audio_text: 들어보세요: 마흔다섯, 스물셋, 서른넷. 작은 수부터 큰 수 순서로 놓으세요.
hints: 각 숫자의 십의 자리를 비교하세요: 2, 3, 아니면 4?
ko.worked_example: 세 숫자를 마음속으로 말해 보세요. 어느 것이 가장 작나요? 거기서부터 시작하세요.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - 서로 다른 세 십의 자리를 순서대로 정확히 놓았어요. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 각 숫자의 십의 자리를 비교해서 순서를 정하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan tiga angka. Urutkan angka-angka itu.
id.audio_text: Dengarkan: empat puluh lima, dua puluh tiga, tiga puluh empat. Urutkan dari yang terkecil ke yang terbesar.
hints: Bandingkan angka puluhan dari masing-masing: 2, 3, atau 4?
id.worked_example: Ucapkan ketiga angka itu dalam hati. Mana yang paling kecil? Mulai dari situ.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - berhasil diurutkan dengan benar di tiga puluhan yang berbeda. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Bandingkan angka puluhan dari setiap bilangan untuk mengurutkannya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe ba số. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Lắng nghe: bốn mươi lăm, hai mươi ba, ba mươi bốn. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự từ nhỏ đến lớn.
hints: So sánh chữ số hàng chục của mỗi số: 2, 3, hay 4?
vi.worked_example: Đọc thầm cả ba số. Số nào nhỏ nhất? Bắt đầu từ đó.

feedback.correct: 23, 34, 45 - sắp xếp đúng qua ba hàng chục khác nhau. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: So sánh chữ số hàng chục của mỗi số để sắp xếp chúng.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to three numbers. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: Listen: ninety-nine, ninety, eighty-nine. Put them in order from smallest to largest.
hints: Two of these cross the boundary between the eighties and nineties.
questions.worked_example: Say all three numbers to yourself. Which is smallest? Start there.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - correctly ordered across that tricky boundary. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 is in the eighties, but 90 and 99 are in the nineties. Order them carefully.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: ordering numbers heard aloud, out of sequence

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Boundaries like 89/90 are exactly where careful comparison matters most.

analysis.primary_construct: holding three heard numbers in mind and ranking them
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest working-memory task in the module - three numbers must be held and compared simultaneously, purely from sound.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Ordering correctly but slowly shows real comparison ability limited by memory load, not number sense itself.
analysis.parent_note: Holding three numbers in mind at once, from sound alone, is genuinely demanding - celebrate the attempt.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Start with two numbers before moving to three, building working memory gradually.

es.instruction: Escucha tres números. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Escucha: noventa y nueve, noventa, ochenta y nueve. Ponlos en orden de menor a mayor.
hints: Dos de estos cruzan el límite entre los ochenta y los noventa.
es.worked_example: Dite los tres números a ti mismo. ¿Cuál es el más pequeño? Empieza por ahí.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99: ordenados correctamente a través de ese límite tan engañoso. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 está en los ochenta, pero 90 y 99 están en los noventa. Ordénalos con cuidado.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute trois nombres. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: Écoute : quatre-vingt-dix-neuf, quatre-vingt-dix, quatre-vingt-neuf. Mets-les dans l'ordre du plus petit au plus grand.
hints: Deux de ces nombres franchissent la frontière entre quatre-vingts et quatre-vingt-dix.
fr.worked_example: Dis les trois nombres dans ta tête. Lequel est le plus petit ? Commence par là.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - bien ordonnés malgré cette frontière délicate. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 est dans les quatre-vingts, mais 90 et 99 sont dans les quatre-vingt-dix. Ordonne-les avec attention.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça três números. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Ouça: noventa e nove, noventa, oitenta e nove. Coloque-os em ordem do menor ao maior.
hints: Dois destes cruzam a fronteira entre os oitenta e os noventa.
pt.worked_example: Diga os três números para si mesmo. Qual é o menor? Comece por aí.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - ordenados corretamente através dessa fronteira complicada. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 está na faixa dos oitenta, mas 90 e 99 estão na faixa dos noventa. Ordene-os com cuidado.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta tre numeri. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Ascolta: novantanove, novanta, ottantanove. Mettili in ordine dal più piccolo al più grande.
hints: Due di questi attraversano il confine tra gli ottanta e i novanta.
it.worked_example: Dì a te stesso tutti e tre i numeri. Quale è il più piccolo? Inizia da lì.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - ordinati correttamente attraverso quel confine difficile. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 è negli ottanta, ma 90 e 99 sono nei novanta. Ordinali con attenzione.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre dir drei Zahlen an. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Höre zu: neunundneunzig, neunzig, neunundachtzig. Bringe sie in die Reihenfolge von der kleinsten zur größten.
hints: Zwei dieser Zahlen liegen an der Grenze zwischen den Achtzigern und Neunzigern.
de.worked_example: Sprich alle drei Zahlen für dich. Welche ist am kleinsten? Fang dort an.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - richtig angeordnet über diese knifflige Grenze. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 liegt bei den Achtzigern, aber 90 und 99 liegen bei den Neunzigern. Ordne sie sorgfältig.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar drie getallen. Zet ze op volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Luister: negenennegentig, negentig, negenentachtig. Zet ze op volgorde van kleinste naar grootste.
hints: Twee hiervan liggen over de grens tussen de tachtigers en negentigers.
nl.worked_example: Zeg alle drie de getallen in jezelf. Welke is het kleinst? Begin daar.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - juist geordend over die lastige grens. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 ligt bij de tachtigers, maar 90 en 99 liggen bij de negentigers. Orden ze zorgvuldig.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Послушай три числа. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Слушай: девяносто девять, девяносто, восемьдесят девять. Расставь их по порядку от самого маленького до самого большого.
hints: Два из этих чисел находятся по разные стороны границы между восьмидесятыми и девяностыми.
ru.worked_example: Повтори все три числа про себя. Какое самое маленькое? Начни с него.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 — расставлено верно через эту непростую границу. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 — это восьмидесятые, а 90 и 99 — девяностые. Расставляй внимательно.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Üç sayıyı dinle. Onları sıraya diz.
tr.audio_text: Dinle: doksan dokuz, doksan, seksen dokuz. Onları en küçükten en büyüğe sırala.
hints: Bunlardan ikisi seksenler ile doksanlar arasındaki sınırı aşıyor.
tr.worked_example: Üç sayıyı da kendine söyle. Hangisi en küçük? Oradan başla.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - o zorlu sınırı aşarak doğru sıralandı. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 seksenlerde, ama 90 ve 99 doksanlarda. Onları dikkatlice sırala.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.instruction: 听三个数字。把它们排序。
zh.audio_text: 听:九十九、九十、八十九。把它们从小到大排序。
hints: 其中两个跨过了八十几和九十几之间的界限。
zh.worked_example: 自己念一念这三个数字。哪个最小?从那个开始。

feedback.correct: 89、90、99——正确跨过了这个容易出错的界限排序。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89是八十几,但90和99是九十几。仔细排序。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 3つの数字を聞こう。順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いてみよう:99、90、89。小さい順に並べよう。
hints: 2つは80代と90代の境目をまたいでいるよ。
ja.worked_example: 3つの数字を声に出してみよう。どれが一番小さい?そこから始めよう。

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - 紛らわしい境目を越えて正しく並べられたね。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89は80代、でも90と99は90代だよ。注意深く並べよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 세 개의 숫자를 들어보세요. 순서대로 놓으세요.
ko.audio_text: 들어보세요: 아흔아홉, 아흔, 여든아홉. 작은 수부터 큰 수 순서로 놓으세요.
hints: 이 중 두 수는 80대와 90대 사이의 경계를 넘어가요.
ko.worked_example: 세 숫자를 마음속으로 말해 보세요. 어느 것이 가장 작나요? 거기서부터 시작하세요.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - 까다로운 경계를 넘어 순서대로 정확히 놓았어요. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89는 80대지만 90과 99는 90대예요. 조심해서 순서를 정하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan tiga angka. Urutkan angka-angka itu.
id.audio_text: Dengarkan: sembilan puluh sembilan, sembilan puluh, delapan puluh sembilan. Urutkan dari yang terkecil ke yang terbesar.
hints: Dua di antaranya melewati batas antara delapan puluhan dan sembilan puluhan.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan ketiga angka itu dalam hati. Mana yang paling kecil? Mulai dari situ.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - berhasil diurutkan dengan benar melewati batas yang tricky itu. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 ada di delapan puluhan, tetapi 90 dan 99 ada di sembilan puluhan. Urutkan dengan teliti.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe ba số. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Lắng nghe: chín mươi chín, chín mươi, tám mươi chín. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự từ nhỏ đến lớn.
hints: Hai trong số này vượt ranh giới giữa nhóm tám mươi mấy và chín mươi mấy.
vi.worked_example: Đọc thầm cả ba số. Số nào nhỏ nhất? Bắt đầu từ đó.

feedback.correct: 89, 90, 99 - sắp xếp đúng qua ranh giới khó đó. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 89 thuộc nhóm tám mươi mấy, nhưng 90 và 99 thuộc nhóm chín mươi mấy. Sắp xếp chúng cẩn thận.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen. Tap the answer.
questions.audio_text: A pizza is cut into 3 equal slices. If you eat 2, what fraction is left?

distractor_insight.2/3: gave the amount eaten instead of what's left
distractor_insight.3/3: described the whole, not what remains

hints: Three slices total, two eaten - how many remain?
questions.worked_example: If everyone gets the same amount, how many equal parts do you need?

feedback.correct: 1/3. One slice out of three remains. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Three slices, two eaten - count what's left out of the total.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: early fraction reasoning through fair sharing

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Knowing exactly what's left, as a fraction, is more precise than guessing 'a bit'.

analysis.primary_construct: reasoning about equal parts of a whole from a spoken sharing scenario
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Introduces fractions through the intuitive, familiar idea of fair sharing rather than abstract notation.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Choosing unequal-looking pieces as fair shows the concept of equal parts, not just splitting, needs reinforcing.
analysis.parent_note: Fair sharing is a fraction a young child already understands intuitively - this just names it.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice sharing snacks equally between people and naming the fraction out loud.

es.instruction: Escucha. Toca la respuesta.
es.audio_text: Una pizza se corta en 3 porciones iguales. Si comes 2, ¿qué fracción queda?
hints: Tres porciones en total, dos comidas: ¿cuántas quedan?
es.worked_example: Si todos reciben la misma cantidad, ¿cuántas partes iguales necesitas?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Queda una porción de tres. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Tres porciones, dos comidas: cuenta lo que queda del total.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.audio_text: Une pizza est coupée en 3 parts égales. Si tu en manges 2, quelle fraction reste-t-il ?
hints: Trois parts en tout, deux mangées - combien en reste-t-il ?
fr.worked_example: Si tout le monde reçoit la même quantité, combien de parts égales te faut-il ?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Une part sur trois reste. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Trois parts, deux mangées - compte ce qui reste sur le total.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça. Toque na resposta.
pt.audio_text: Uma pizza é cortada em 3 pedaços iguais. Se você come 2, que fração resta?
hints: Três pedaços no total, dois comidos - quantos restam?
pt.worked_example: Se todos recebem a mesma quantidade, quantas partes iguais você precisa?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Um pedaço de três resta. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Três pedaços, dois comidos - conte o que resta do total.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta. Tocca la risposta.
it.audio_text: Una pizza è tagliata in 3 fette uguali. Se ne mangi 2, che frazione resta?
hints: Tre fette in totale, due mangiate - quante ne restano?
it.worked_example: Se tutti ricevono la stessa quantità, quante parti uguali servono?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Resta una fetta su tre. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Tre fette, due mangiate - conta cosa resta sul totale.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre zu. Tippe die Antwort.
de.audio_text: Eine Pizza wird in 3 gleiche Stücke geschnitten. Wenn du 2 isst, welcher Anteil bleibt übrig?
hints: Drei Stücke insgesamt, zwei gegessen - wie viele bleiben übrig?
de.worked_example: Wenn alle den gleichen Anteil bekommen, wie viele gleiche Teile brauchst du?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Ein Stück von drei bleibt übrig. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Drei Stücke, zwei gegessen - zähle, was von der Gesamtzahl übrig bleibt.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Een pizza wordt in 3 gelijke stukken gesneden. Als je er 2 opeet, welke breuk blijft er over?
hints: Drie stukken totaal, twee opgegeten - hoeveel blijven er over?
nl.worked_example: Als iedereen evenveel krijgt, hoeveel gelijke delen heb je dan nodig?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Eén stuk van de drie blijft over. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Drie stukken, twee opgegeten - tel wat er overblijft van het totaal.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.audio_text: Пиццу разрезали на 3 равные части. Если ты съешь 2, какая доля останется?
hints: Всего три куска, два съедены — сколько осталось?
ru.worked_example: Если всем нужно одинаковое количество, на сколько равных частей нужно разделить?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Остаётся один кусок из трёх. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Три куска, два съедены — посчитай, сколько осталось от общего числа.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.audio_text: Bir pizza 3 eşit dilime bölünüyor. 2'sini yersen, kaçta kaçı kalır?
hints: Toplam üç dilim, ikisi yendi - kaçı kalır?
tr.worked_example: Herkes aynı miktarı alacaksa, kaç eşit parçaya ihtiyacın var?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Üç dilimden biri kalır. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Üç dilim, ikisi yendi - toplamdan kalanı say.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.audio_text: 一个披萨被切成3等份。如果你吃了2份,还剩多少分之几?
hints: 总共3份,吃了2份——还剩多少份?
zh.worked_example: 如果每人分到的一样多,需要分成多少等份?

feedback.correct: 1/3。三份里还剩一份。🍕
feedback.incorrect: 3份里吃了2份——数出剩下的占总数的几份。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 聞いてみよう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.audio_text: ピザが3枚の等しいスライスに切られています。2枚食べたら、残りはどれだけの分数かな?
hints: 全部で3枚、2枚食べたよ。残りは何枚?
ja.worked_example: みんなが同じ量をもらうなら、何個の等しい部分が必要かな?

feedback.correct: 1/3。3枚のうち1枚が残っているね。🍕
feedback.incorrect: 3枚のうち2枚食べたよ。残りを数えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.audio_text: 피자를 3개의 똑같은 조각으로 잘랐어요. 2조각을 먹으면, 몇 분의 몇이 남을까요?
hints: 전체 3조각 중 2조각을 먹었어요 - 몇 조각이 남을까요?
ko.worked_example: 모두가 똑같이 나눠 가진다면, 몇 개의 똑같은 조각이 필요할까요?

feedback.correct: 1/3. 3조각 중 1조각이 남아요. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: 3조각 중 2조각을 먹었어요 - 전체에서 남은 조각을 세어 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.audio_text: Sebuah pizza dipotong menjadi 3 potong yang sama. Jika kamu makan 2, berapa pecahan yang tersisa?
hints: Total tiga potong, dua dimakan - berapa yang tersisa?
id.worked_example: Jika semua orang mendapat jumlah yang sama, berapa bagian sama besar yang kamu butuhkan?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Tersisa satu potong dari tiga. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Tiga potong, dua dimakan - hitung sisanya dari totalnya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Lắng nghe. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.audio_text: Một cái bánh pizza được cắt thành 3 phần bằng nhau. Nếu em ăn 2 phần, còn lại bao nhiêu phần?
hints: Tổng cộng ba phần, ăn hai phần - còn lại bao nhiêu?
vi.worked_example: Nếu mọi người nhận phần bằng nhau, em cần chia thành bao nhiêu phần?

feedback.correct: 1/3. Còn lại một phần trên tổng số ba phần. 🍕
feedback.incorrect: Ba phần, ăn hai phần - đếm số còn lại trên tổng số.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to three numbers. Put them in order.
questions.audio_text: Listen: sixty-one, sixteen, fifty-five. Put them in order from smallest to largest.
hints: Two of these use the same digits in a different order - be extra careful.
questions.worked_example: Say all three numbers to yourself. Which is smallest? Start there.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - correctly ordered, including that reversed-digit pair. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 and 16 use the same digits but mean very different amounts. Compare the tens digit first.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: ordering numbers heard aloud, out of sequence

life_skill.primary: Ordering numbers with tricky reversed pairs
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Reversed-digit pairs are exactly where a careful second look pays off.

analysis.primary_construct: holding three heard numbers in mind and ranking them
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest working-memory task in the module - three numbers must be held and compared simultaneously, purely from sound.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Ordering correctly but slowly shows real comparison ability limited by memory load, not number sense itself.
analysis.parent_note: Holding three numbers in mind at once, from sound alone, is genuinely demanding - celebrate the attempt.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Start with two numbers before moving to three, building working memory gradually.

es.instruction: Escucha tres números. Ponlos en orden.
es.audio_text: Escucha: sesenta y uno, dieciséis, cincuenta y cinco. Ponlos en orden de menor a mayor.
hints: Dos de estos usan las mismas cifras en otro orden: ten mucho cuidado.
es.worked_example: Dite los tres números a ti mismo. ¿Cuál es el más pequeño? Empieza por ahí.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61: ordenados correctamente, incluyendo ese par de cifras invertidas. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 y 16 usan las mismas cifras pero significan cantidades muy distintas. Compara primero la cifra de las decenas.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Écoute trois nombres. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.audio_text: Écoute : soixante et un, seize, cinquante-cinq. Mets-les dans l'ordre du plus petit au plus grand.
hints: Deux de ces nombres utilisent les mêmes chiffres dans un ordre différent - fais très attention.
fr.worked_example: Dis les trois nombres dans ta tête. Lequel est le plus petit ? Commence par là.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - bien ordonnés, y compris cette paire aux chiffres inversés. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 et 16 utilisent les mêmes chiffres mais représentent des quantités très différentes. Compare d'abord le chiffre des dizaines.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Ouça três números. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.audio_text: Ouça: sessenta e um, dezesseis, cinquenta e cinco. Coloque-os em ordem do menor ao maior.
hints: Dois destes usam os mesmos algarismos em ordem diferente - tenha cuidado extra.
pt.worked_example: Diga os três números para si mesmo. Qual é o menor? Comece por aí.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - ordenados corretamente, incluindo aquele par de algarismos invertidos. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 e 16 usam os mesmos algarismos, mas significam quantidades muito diferentes. Compare primeiro o algarismo das dezenas.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Ascolta tre numeri. Mettili in ordine.
it.audio_text: Ascolta: sessantuno, sedici, cinquantacinque. Mettili in ordine dal più piccolo al più grande.
hints: Due di questi usano le stesse cifre in ordine diverso - fai molta attenzione.
it.worked_example: Dì a te stesso tutti e tre i numeri. Quale è il più piccolo? Inizia da lì.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - ordinati correttamente, incluso quel paio con cifre invertite. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 e 16 usano le stesse cifre ma rappresentano quantità molto diverse. Confronta prima la cifra delle decine.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Höre dir drei Zahlen an. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.audio_text: Höre zu: einundsechzig, sechzehn, fünfundfünfzig. Bringe sie in die Reihenfolge von der kleinsten zur größten.
hints: Zwei dieser Zahlen verwenden die gleichen Ziffern in anderer Reihenfolge - sei besonders vorsichtig.
de.worked_example: Sprich alle drei Zahlen für dich. Welche ist am kleinsten? Fang dort an.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - richtig angeordnet, auch das Paar mit vertauschten Ziffern. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 und 16 verwenden die gleichen Ziffern, bedeuten aber sehr unterschiedliche Mengen. Vergleiche zuerst die Zehnerstelle.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Luister naar drie getallen. Zet ze op volgorde.
nl.audio_text: Luister: eenenzestig, zestien, vijfenvijftig. Zet ze op volgorde van kleinste naar grootste.
hints: Twee hiervan gebruiken dezelfde cijfers in een andere volgorde - wees extra voorzichtig.
nl.worked_example: Zeg alle drie de getallen in jezelf. Welke is het kleinst? Begin daar.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - juist geordend, inclusief dat omgedraaide cijferpaar. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 en 16 gebruiken dezelfde cijfers maar betekenen heel andere aantallen. Vergelijk eerst het tiental.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Послушай три числа. Расставь их по порядку.
ru.audio_text: Слушай: шестьдесят один, шестнадцать, пятьдесят пять. Расставь их по порядку от самого маленького до самого большого.
hints: Два из этих чисел состоят из одних и тех же цифр, но в другом порядке — будь особенно внимателен.
ru.worked_example: Повтори все три числа про себя. Какое самое маленькое? Начни с него.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 — расставлено верно, включая эту пару с перевёрнутыми цифрами. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 и 16 состоят из одних и тех же цифр, но означают очень разные числа. Сначала сравни цифру десятков.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Üç sayıyı dinle. Onları sıraya diz.
tr.audio_text: Dinle: altmış bir, on altı, elli beş. Onları en küçükten en büyüğe sırala.
hints: Bunlardan ikisi aynı rakamları farklı bir sırada kullanıyor - çok dikkatli ol.
tr.worked_example: Üç sayıyı da kendine söyle. Hangisi en küçük? Oradan başla.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - o ters çevrilmiş rakam çifti dahil, doğru sıralandı. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 ve 16 aynı rakamları kullanır ama çok farklı miktarlar anlamına gelir. Önce onlar basamağını karşılaştır.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl olduğunu izle.

zh.instruction: 听三个数字。把它们排序。
zh.audio_text: 听:六十一、十六、五十五。把它们从小到大排序。
hints: 其中两个用了相同的数字,顺序不同——格外小心。
zh.worked_example: 自己念一念这三个数字。哪个最小?从那个开始。

feedback.correct: 16、55、61——排序正确,包括那对颠倒数字。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61和16用了相同的数字,但代表的数量完全不同。先比较十位。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 3つの数字を聞こう。順番に並べよう。
ja.audio_text: 聞いてみよう:61、16、55。小さい順に並べよう。
hints: 2つは同じ数字を違う順番で使っているよ。特に注意しよう。
ja.worked_example: 3つの数字を声に出してみよう。どれが一番小さい?そこから始めよう。

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - 入れ替えられた数字のペアも含めて正しく並べられたね。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61と16は同じ数字を使っているけど、全く違う量だよ。まず十の位を比べよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 세 개의 숫자를 들어보세요. 순서대로 놓으세요.
ko.audio_text: 들어보세요: 예순하나, 열여섯, 쉰다섯. 작은 수부터 큰 수 순서로 놓으세요.
hints: 두 수는 같은 숫자를 다른 순서로 써요 - 더욱 조심하세요.
ko.worked_example: 세 숫자를 마음속으로 말해 보세요. 어느 것이 가장 작나요? 거기서부터 시작하세요.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - 숫자가 뒤집힌 짝까지 순서대로 정확히 놓았어요. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61과 16은 같은 숫자를 쓰지만 전혀 다른 수예요. 먼저 십의 자리를 비교하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan tiga angka. Urutkan angka-angka itu.
id.audio_text: Dengarkan: enam puluh satu, enam belas, lima puluh lima. Urutkan dari yang terkecil ke yang terbesar.
hints: Dua di antaranya memakai digit yang sama dengan urutan berbeda - hati-hati ekstra.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan ketiga angka itu dalam hati. Mana yang paling kecil? Mulai dari situ.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - berhasil diurutkan dengan benar, termasuk pasangan digit terbalik itu. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 dan 16 memakai digit yang sama tetapi nilainya sangat berbeda. Bandingkan dulu angka puluhannya.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita coba bersama - lihat caranya.

vi.instruction: Nghe ba số. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự.
vi.audio_text: Lắng nghe: sáu mươi mốt, mười sáu, năm mươi lăm. Sắp xếp chúng theo thứ tự từ nhỏ đến lớn.
hints: Hai trong số này dùng cùng các chữ số nhưng theo thứ tự khác - hãy đặc biệt cẩn thận.
vi.worked_example: Đọc thầm cả ba số. Số nào nhỏ nhất? Bắt đầu từ đó.

feedback.correct: 16, 55, 61 - sắp xếp đúng, kể cả cặp số đảo chữ số đó. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 61 và 16 dùng cùng các chữ số nhưng có giá trị rất khác nhau. So sánh chữ số hàng chục trước.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này nhé - xem cách thực hiện.
